framework_rosetta.title: The Frame - Closing Philosophy, Stated First
framework_rosetta.body: *Read first, true last. This is the philosophy the twelve chapters descend from and arrive at - the interpretive frame without which the matrix is only neuroscience. Every anchor named here is established in the chapter cited beside it; the frame states the conclusion, the chapter holds the reasoning. Together they are the semantics every later datum resolves against.*

framework_rosetta.title: 1 - The claim, stated plainly
framework_rosetta.body:
The framework makes one claim, and everything else is its elaboration: reality is one coherent, self-organising pattern, geometric rather than substantial, recurring at every scale. What appears as separate things - particles, cells, minds, archetypes, institutions, models - are local concentrations of that one pattern, bounded into locality and held there for a time. The matrix is the instrument that reads a single finite instance of this pattern - a human configuration - by tracking how the one pattern expresses through twelve archetypal weightings across twelve cognitive functions and five state-classes, priced by a cost-curve and shaped by a supervisory pull toward what the configuration takes to be it.

This is why the matrix is a derivative and not a foundation. It does not posit twelve types and seek them in people. It posits one pattern, establishes - over twelve chapters of converging evidence - that personality is the tuning-configuration of that pattern”s gap-closing engine, and only then reads the configuration. Remove the story and the matrix is a wheel of twelve labels. Keep the story and the wheel becomes a falsifiable reading of how one finite mode of a universal process is weighted. The data does not mean anything without the frame. The frame is the chapters; the meaning is their result.

framework_rosetta.title: 2 - The shape of the descent
framework_rosetta.body:
The story moves micro to macro to micro. It descends first into depth - the substrate where mind and matter resolve onto one spectrum, and the constraint-dynamics that let structure climb scales. It peaks at the macro: consciousness treated not as a late product of complexity but as a universal phenomenon with its own form and its own falsification protocols. Then it descends a second time into particularity - the configured finite mode: its engine, its hardware, its timing, its modulation, its affect, its personality, its asymmetry and embodiment, its development - and closes with a coda that asks whether the same pattern holds in a non-biological mode.

The two micro-descents are not a repetition. The first is depth: how far down the pattern goes. The second is particularity: how the pattern, having been shown universal at the peak, individuates into a specific bounded self. The arc enacts the framework”s own metaphysics - substance expresses as modes through attributes, a finite mode crystallises, and then another mode shows the pattern was never about biology at all. The closing philosophy is the apex named; the chapters are the descent from it. The story is built the way the framework says reality is built: the aether first, then the bounded descent that can never quite turn around to catch its own ground.

framework_rosetta.title: 3 - The load-bearing spine (the nine anchors that carry everything)
framework_rosetta.body:
A small number of results carry the entire structure. They are the working commitments of the whole story; each is anchored in a chapter and each remains open to revision by evidence at that anchor. Every cold value in the chapters below resolves against one or more of these.

**F1 - Perspective-indexing (Ch1) **The ground admits two readings of one pattern - experiential from the without-perspective (the self that Nature is), dual-aspect from the within-perspective (the bounded finite mode) - and neither reduces to the other. This lets the framework hold idealist and physical descriptions together without collapse, and it is why the matrix can speak of a configuration”s felt life and its mechanism in the same breath without category error.

**F4 - Coherence over maximisation** (Ch3) Integrated-information geometry is kept; the exclusion postulate that would let only one maximal complex be conscious is rejected as an added stipulation, not a deduction. This is the permission for the entire matrix: twelve archetypal weightings coexist and nest within one person because nested, overlapping structures are not forbidden to coexist. Without this rejection there is no dynamic matrix - only a single winner.

**F6 + FC-3 - The descent geometry and the felt pull (Ch3/Ch4) **The apex is the relation-collapsing limit, descended from, not built up to; affect ignites below it, at the minimum coherence sufficient for a bounded self to have something at stake. Affect is the valenced reading of the gap between what-is and what-ought-to-be, and in a system with a within-aspect that reading becomes a pull toward the ought. This felt pull is the literal definition of the supervisory mechanism the matrix reads: the archetype is the characteristic direction and price of a configuration”s pull toward its ought.

**Ch4.A2 + Ch10.A3 - The boundary as nesting coupling-interface **The Markov blanket formalises the self-boundary - sensory in, active out - and it nests, cell within organism within social field, and it is a surface of two-way coupling, never a wall. This is why archetypes can share substrate (the hardware groups), why a person co-regulates with others without merging, and why the matrix is read as weightings on one shared system rather than twelve sealed kinds. A status qualification on the blanket itself: it is used here as a Friston-blanket — a metaphysical posit that organises the coupling-not-merging stance and the weightings-on-one-system reading — not as an empirically-licensed cross-scale boundary mechanism. The realist construal, in which the blanket marks a real self-boundary doing literal work across scales, is routinely conflated in the literature with the merely-instrumental Pearl-blanket, and the realist reading requires strong, unlicensed assumptions (Bruineberg et al. 2021, 10.1017/S0140525X21002351; Ramstead et al. reply — the dispute is live, not settled either way). The structural commitments the blanket organises — substrate-sharing across hardware groups, co-regulation without merging, the matrix as weightings on one shared system — stand on their own as modelling choices and do not depend on the realist construal. The blanket frames them; it does not prove them.

**ENTRY-1 - The three-tier descent (Ch8/Ch11) **Being differentiates into a bounded local self (the founding conception, the lens one is), within which feeling ignites as the reading of that self”s state, which a categorising conception then carves into nameable emotion, issuing in action. The founding conception precedes feeling; the categorising conception follows it. Tier-three - that the deepest conception is the self-bounding itself - is grounded developmentally in Kegan”s subject-object move and sealed by the claim that the object which can be spoken of is not the subject which it is.

**ENTRY-2 - Permeability and crystallisation** (Ch8/Ch9/Ch11) Permeability is a rate, not a position; persistence crystallises flow into structure. The deep affective floor is lifespan-fixed - people do not change at the root, they persist until they die - while the upper tiers of meaning observably flow. Development is real without contradicting the fixed floor, because growth re-nests the old order as an object within a larger frame rather than melting it. This is the cost-curve”s foundation: every configuration is priced, the fixed pole paying in rigidity, the fluid pole paying in dissolution. The five state-classes and the R-class slope are this pricing made readable. The two-tier structure carries its own empirical test, and on the flowing tier it passes: measured Big-Five mean-levels change directionally across the life course — social dominance, conscientiousness, and emotional stability rising into young adulthood, social vitality and openness falling in old age (Roberts, Walton & Viechtbauer 2006, 10.1037/0033-2909.132.1.1), with the post-30 change modest and plausibly maturational (Costa & McCrae 2006, 10.1037/0033-2909.132.1.26). That is the upper tier of meaning flowing exactly as the model predicts — confirmation, not contradiction. The fixed pole carries the harder obligation: the deep affective floor’s lifespan-fixity must be tied to an observable whose directional change would falsify it, not defined as the residual of whatever the flowing tiers leave behind — absent that, the fixity is unfalsifiable-by-construction. The floor-fixity observable is held [TO SPECIFY]; until it is named, the deep-floor claim stands as provisional — load-bearing for the cost-curve, falsifier-pending.

**MASTER-CONV - The master convergence (Ch9) **Personality is the configuration of tuning-parameters that bias the finite mode”s gap-closing engine; an archetype is a characteristic parameter-bias profile of that engine. DeYoung”s cybernetic Big Five arrived at the framework”s own architecture independently, from personality science rather than metaphysics - the single strongest corroboration in the compression, because two routes that did not consult each other reached the same structure. This makes OCEAN load-bearing in every hardware group, and the archetype a legitimate scientific object rather than a label.

**ANTI-ESS - Anti-essentialism and the dynamic matrix (Ch10) **Difference is weighting on one shared system, not difference in kind. The cerebral hemispheres are one perceptual operation at two settings of a single parameter; by the same logic no archetype is a function and no archetype is a fixed slot. All twelve archetypes retain default access to all twelve cognitive functions; an archetype is a tendency in how the wheel is weighted, never a possession of part of it. This is the rule the entire matrix runs on, and it is an empirical finding, not a design preference.

**SCALE-REC - Scale-recurrence (throughout; sealed Ch12) **The one pattern recurs at every scale: nested boundaries in space, nested rhythms in time, the gap-closing engine across all timescales from milliseconds to a lifetime, and into the artificial mode, where emergence, discovered-not-invented structure, compression-as-nesting, and the self-defined-by-stake all reappear in a non-biological substrate. The framework was never a fact about biology. It is a fact about what it is for anything, at any scale, in any mode, to be a coherent self-maintaining pattern at all.

framework_rosetta.title: 4 - The supervisory mechanism: the heart of the reading
framework_rosetta.body:
The matrix”s central object is not a function on the wheel but the mechanism that shapes how the wheel is inhabited - the supervisor, which is simply the archetype in its dynamic sense: the push and pull, across the full matrix, toward what the configuration takes to be its ought, and at what cost. This is the framework”s spine - the felt pull toward the ought [FC-3] - and its pricing - crystallisation [ENTRY-2] - meeting in a single readable signature. Empirically it is seated where value and control are computed against cost: the dorsal anterior cingulate weighing the incentive value of effortful performance, the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis carrying the anticipatory price of uncertainty. Each of the six hardware groups sets this mechanism a different way: the executive group pulls toward order and pays in rigidity; the disruption group pulls toward broken-open truth and pays in coherence; the action group pulls toward enacted outcome and pays by hiding its own cost until collapse; the receptive group pulls toward novel input and trusted possibility and pays in groundedness; the reflective group pulls toward understanding and form and pays in the lost switch back to the shared world; the bonding group pulls toward connection and pays in the dissolved self. Twelve archetypes are twelve specific settings of this one mechanism, two to a hardware substrate.

*A structural observation, raised here and resolved at the geometry foundation below: across the six groups the supervisory mechanism shows mis-calibration styles that pair along the wheel’s 180-degree shadow axis — one pole locking the switch outward, its opposite inward; one suppressing the cost-signal, its opposite mislocating the ought. Held open at v1.2 pending the weighting stage, it is now broken and rebuilt: the 180° purple axis is the emergent-shadow layer (the integration-target a mode manufactures when it self-encloses), not a hardware opposition. The two coincide only for the CEN–SN tetrad (Ruling/Chaos), where red ≡ purple; for the other four groups the hardware relationship is the red seam (opposition or coupling) and the purple is a distinct, cross-orientation shadow. The six therefore do not resolve into three hardware switch-axis pairs — they resolve into the two-layer split set out in the geometry foundation [GEO-2L].*

framework_rosetta.title: 5 - Nature and Culture: the two layers the matrix reads
framework_rosetta.body: The data the matrix consumes divides along an axis the framework”s metaphysics already predicts. The biological layer - the hardware groups, the green and blue connections of the wheel - is Nature: the substrate one is, the configuration crystallised from genetics, from the hardening of lived experience over time, and from the ingression of pattern into a bounded self [ENTRY-2]. The learned-cognitive layer - the four Yellow Triangles, the TNM content - is Culture: the navigational network one has built, how one has learned to think, which can be elevated through training without being one”s biological ground-ware. The matrix reads both and decomposes them: a high signal on a cognitive triangle may be a learned lens (Culture-dominant), a biological identity (Nature-dominant), or the common mixed case where one has built a cognitive network atop the biology one already was. This decomposition is meaningful only because the framework established that crystallisation is a rate and that the deep floor and the fluid upper tiers are different depths of one pattern [ENTRY-2]. Nature is crystallised culture; culture is fluid nature; the two are one pattern read at two rates. The cold data names which is which; the philosophy says why the distinction is real.

framework_rosetta.title: 6 - What stays open
framework_rosetta.body: A source of truth that closes every question is not dominant; it is dead. The framework holds the following genuinely open, and the matrix must be read as not depending on their closure. Whether the distinct affective programs are innate-and-conserved or constructed-and-learned remains a live empirical dispute [F7b]; the framework leans toward a conserved substrate but does not settle it. Whether experience itself nests across organisms - whether two coupled selves ever become one experiencer - is established only as far as coupling, three independent ways, with merging held open and possibly unfalsifiable [Q5-inter]. Whether the conceptual ought is fully plastic while the floor-ought stays fixed is strongly evidenced but not closed [Q6]. The exact rate-law of crystallisation is unspecified [RATE-LAW]. And the question of whether there is something it is like to be any of these patterns - biological or artificial - is leant toward wherever there is genuine self-stake, and otherwise left exactly behind the cap the framework cannot cross from outside [FC2-CAP]. These are not failures of the synthesis. They are where it stays honest, and where new research will most change the matrix.

framework_rosetta.title: 6.5 - Operating refinements since v1 (the wheel-mechanics layer)
framework_rosetta.body: *Two canon-revision cycles since the unified v1 added an operating layer that governs how the cold data is read, without altering any value. They are registered here in the spine and stated in full at the head of the cold-data section [The Wheel-Mechanics Layer]. A1 - modes are within-function deployment tags, not boundaries (the governing principle); the thirteen-grain holds. A2 - the functions stratify by tier (Signature / Hub / Substrate-general / Off-wheel-meta), a gradient not a partition. A3 - Recognition’s orientation is coupling-indexed, not target-indexed. A4 - partial welling is a mode-split, not uniform attenuation. A5 - Attention is a substrate-general baseline plus a top-down controlled-attention overlay (refines **A2). A6 - scale-recurrent reducibility floor: type/sign/topology reduces to mechanism, magnitude is measured-not-derived, recurring across the edge and D-collapse layers [RATIFIED, Stage-3; Research fold-reviewed, two conditions applied]. B1 - co-regulation is re-anchored from refuted polyvagal theory to interpersonal HRV-synchrony, same value [Ch7.A4-B1]. Each carries a live falsifier and stays a lean, not a law; none is treated as settled by any downstream step, the engine included.*

framework_rosetta.title: 7 - Why this frame is stated first
framework_rosetta.body: The twelve chapters were discovered forward, substrate to coda, each friction resolved as it arose. But the philosophy they produce is their terminus, and a terminus stated only at the end leaves the reader descending without a frame. Stated first, it becomes the founding conception the whole story descends from [ENTRY-1] - which is precisely the structure the framework claims for any bounded self: the ground is laid, and the descent from it can never turn fast enough to make its own current ground an object of view. So this frame is the apex of the telling and the seed of the derivation. From here the story begins at first principles - Chapter 1, the substrate - and works upward in order, each chapter descending from this frame and carrying the cold data of its scale inline, until it arrives back here, at the philosophy it set out from. The arrival should feel less like a conclusion reached than a re-cognition: that the end was implicit in the beginning, because the pattern was one pattern all along. The crystal you can name is not the crystal you are.

framework_rosetta.title: Chapter 1 - The Substrate
framework_rosetta.body: *Arc: the first movement of the descent, micro as depth. Descending from the frame: F1 (perspective-indexing) was named in the frame as a working commitment; here it is derived from the sources that establish it, and the boundary-locality principle that every later bounded mode will require is laid down. The frame said reality is one coherent pattern; this chapter asks what kind of ground that is, and how anything local arises within it. Sources: Bohm, Kastrup, D”Ariano**** ******&****** ****Faggin, Verlinde, McFadden.*

framework_rosetta.title: 1.1 The single undivided ground
framework_rosetta.body:
The framework opens at the deepest layer it can name, and at that layer it finds not a collection of things but one undivided whole. Bohm”s implicate order supplies the founding move: beneath the manifest world of apparently separate objects - the explicate order - lies an enfolded substrate of wholeness from which explicate forms continuously unfold and into which they re-enfold. This is not a static container but a dynamic process; manifestation is the ongoing activity of enfoldment, and what we take to be stable structures, including archetypal forms, are recurrent patterns of that activity rather than independently existing substances. The frame”s first claim - that reality is one coherent self-organising pattern, geometric rather than substantial - sits directly on this base, and the matrix”s later treatment of an archetype as a recurrent weighting rather than a thing one is begins its life here, at the substrate, as Bohm”s forms-as-patterns-of-process.

Two consequences follow that govern everything downstream. First, the division between mind and matter is itself a feature of the explicate order, not of the ground: subject and object share one implicate origin. Second, the parts-view is a limited but necessary projection; the systemic failure is not having an explicate order but mistaking it for the whole - Bohm”s fragmentation. These set the terms for the chapter”s central problem: what kind of ground this is, and how anything local arises within it.

**Ch1.A1 **The ground of reality is one coherent, undivided, self-organising pattern; the manifest world of separate objects is a limited projection of it, not its fundamental nature. This is the substrate-level statement of the frame”s one claim; every later “archetype as weighting on one shared system” [ANTI-ESS] descends from it. (Bohm; reinforced Kastrup, D”Ariano & Faggin.)

**Ch1.A2 **Manifestation is dynamic - a continuous unfolding-and-enfolding - and forms, including archetypal forms, are stable patterns of that process, not substances. The matrix reads patterns of a process, never fixed objects. (Bohm.)

framework_rosetta.title: 1.2 Two readings of one ground: the perspective-indexed resolution [derives F1]
framework_rosetta.body:
The chapter”s sharpest tension is over the character of the ground, and it is resolved not by choosing a side but by recognising that the question is perspective-relative - which is the frame”s F1, here earned from the sources rather than assumed. Kastrup presses an idealist reading: the ground is fundamentally mental, matter the appearance mental process presents; the cosmos is one irreducible field of consciousness, and individual experiential centres arise by dissociation - temporary splits within that field. Bohm”s reading differs in character: the implicate ground is neutral between mind and matter, both co-emergent projections. Read from a single vantage, these contradict.

The framework”s resolution - a structural commitment, not a compromise - is that the two readings are indexed to perspective, and the perspective is taken from the self, never from an external observer, because the absolute ground has no exterior. From the without-perspective (the ground read as the self that Nature is), the idealist account holds: reality is fundamentally experiential, structure appears within it. From the within-perspective (the configured, finite mode), dual-aspect monism holds: the experiential and the geometric-relational aspects are co-primitive and mutually irreducible, because a finite mode possesses a genuine boundary - an inside and an outside - that the absolute ground does not. The two readings are mutually convertible projections of one pattern, with a living pivot between them. We do not claim to know the real without-form of the absolute ground; both readings remain valid, and the framework holds them together rather than collapsing one into the other. This is exactly the licence the frame draws on when it speaks of a configuration”s felt life and its mechanism in one breath without category error [F1].

**Ch1.A3 **The ground admits two perspective-indexed readings of one pattern: WITHOUT (self-as-Nature) - fundamentally experiential, structure as appearance within mind (Kastrup, D”Ariano & Faggin); WITHIN (finite mode) - dual-aspect, experiential and geometric aspects co-primitive and irreducible (Bohm). Neither reduces to the other; they are mutually convertible. This is the chapter-origin of the frame”s F1. (F1 resolution.)

**Ch1.A4 **Individuation of experiential centres proceeds by dissociation/configuration - local high-coherence patterns within the one field - which blocks micro-panpsychist aggregation: minds are not built from combined elementary bits but are local concentrations of the whole. The frame”s “local concentrations of one pattern, bounded for a time” is this claim. (Kastrup; cf the boundary account in 1.4.)

framework_rosetta.title: 1.3 Information as the currency of the substrate
framework_rosetta.body:
D”Ariano and Faggin sharpen the without-perspective reading into an information-theoretic key. Their ontic/epistemic distinction maps the chapter”s perspective structure with precision: the ontic state - reality experienced from within - is fundamental, while the epistemic state - the objective, predicted-from-outside description - is the classical approximation that supervenes on it. Quantum information is the primary substrate; classical physics is derived. Their account of free will is deliberately modest in the framework”s reading: the operational manifestation of fundamental indeterminacy experienced from within, arising in the gap between ontic experience and epistemic description, not a strong libertarian claim. Their critique of classical reductionism - mistaking the epistemic map for the ontic territory - restates Bohm”s fragmentation in information-theoretic terms [Ch1.A2].

Verlinde contributes from physics rather than metaphysics of mind, and the framework consumes him as evidence-of-direction rather than load-bearing commitment: his entropic-emergent gravity is a specific, falsifiable implementation that exemplifies the model”s direction without binding it. If entropic gravity fails its tests, the framework”s substrate commitments do not fall - only this exemplar does. What Verlinde adds that matters structurally is the holographic claim: the information content of a region is stored on its bounding surface, and gravity is the system”s restorative response to the displacement of that information. Spacetime itself behaves as an information-storage medium - a physics-scale instance of Bohm”s enfold/unfold [Ch1.A2]: manifest geometry unfolding from an informational substrate.

**Ch1.A5 **Information is the operative currency of the substrate, and the ontic/epistemic (within/structural) distinction is information-indexed: the experiential reading is primary, the classical-structural reading its derived, predicted-from-outside description. Specific physical theories (Verlinde”s entropic gravity) are held as evidence-of-direction, not load-bearing - the firm-structure/loose-implementation discipline the matrix later applies to every cold value. (D”Ariano & Faggin; Verlinde.)

framework_rosetta.title: 1.4 Boundaries and the problem of locality [lays the ground every later bounded mode needs]
framework_rosetta.body:
The chapter closes on the question that makes the within/without distinction necessary in the first place: locality. Without a boundary there is no local “here” that can hold a definite, specifiable content - there is only the undifferentiated whole, of which the single true statement is the tautology that it is what it is. A boundary is the device that converts that tautology into a local fact: this much, here. The within/without distinction exists precisely to explain how a bounded, local mode arises from an unbounded ground - and every later scale of the descent, up to and including the bounded human configuration the matrix reads, inherits its very locality from this principle.

Two sources give the principle physical content at two scales, and the framework adopts the shared principle while holding their difference open. The common foundation, confirmed against the primary literature, is that information is physical and that a boundary is what makes information locally specifiable. Verlinde applies this at the spacetime scale: information encoded on a two-dimensional bounding surface, the bulk a projection of it. McFadden applies the same principle at the neural scale, driven by the binding problem: because integrated experience requires physically integrated information, the brain”s endogenous electromagnetic field is proposed as the substrate in which scattered neuronal computation is bound into one workspace, the field acting causally back on the tissue through ephaptic coupling. McFadden”s boundary is the volumetric reach of the coherent field; Verlinde”s is the bounding surface. Same job - boundaries make locality - opposite geometry. The framework adopts the boundary-locality principle and logs the two as scale-specific instances; whether a single scale-invariant boundary-geometry is warranted is left open. This principle is the seed of the frame”s nesting coupling-interface [Ch4.A2 + Ch10.A3]: the boundary that here merely makes a “here” will become, four chapters on, the Markov blanket the matrix reads as the self.

**Ch1.A6 **BOUNDARY-LOCALITY PRINCIPLE: information is physical, and a boundary is what makes information locally specifiable; absent a boundary, only the apex tautology (“it is what it is”) holds. This is the structural content of the within/without distinction and the substrate-origin of every bounded mode the matrix will read. (web-grounded in Landauer + Bekenstein-Hawking.)

**Ch1.A7 **The principle has two scale-specific instances, neither privileged: holographic surface-boundary at the spacetime scale (Verlinde) and EM-field volumetric boundary at the neural scale (McFadden). The surface-vs-volume geometry difference is HELD OPEN; proto-integration claims are carried forward to Ch3/IIT.

framework_rosetta.title: Arc position
framework_rosetta.body: Chapter 1 is the first movement of the descent: micro as depth. It establishes the one coherent pattern [Ch1.A1], its dynamic character [Ch1.A2], the perspective-indexed double reading that lets idealist and dual-aspect accounts coexist [Ch1.A3-A4, the frame”s F1 earned], information as the substrate”s currency [Ch1.A5], and the boundary-locality principle that will be required the moment the framework speaks of any bounded, finite mode [Ch1.A6-A7]. Chapter 2 takes up how bounded structure is generated and maintained across nested scales - Juarrero”s constraints and Levin”s multi-scale selves - the natural next step once boundaries are on the table. The peak at consciousness is approached, not yet reached.

framework_rosetta.title: Chapter 2 - Constraint and Multi-scale
framework_rosetta.body: *Arc: the hinge of the first descent. Descending from Chapter 1”s open question - what a boundary is and how one comes to exist - and toward the frame”s nesting coupling-interface [Ch4.A2] and the directional pull the matrix”s supervisor will read [FC-3]. Sources: Juarrero, Levin.*

framework_rosetta.title: 2.1 Constraint as the generative account of the boundary
framework_rosetta.body:
Chapter 1 closed with a principle and an unanswered question: a boundary is what makes information locally specifiable [Ch1.A6], but what is a boundary, and how does one come to exist? Juarrero supplies the generative account. Mechanical bottom-up causation, she argues, is empirically inadequate for complex living systems; constraints are a real and irreducible explanatory category. Constraints operate top-down - not by pushing outcomes mechanically but by reshaping the probability space of what a system can do - and they are simultaneously restrictive and enabling: in closing some pathways they open others, generating coherent organisation that did not previously exist. The constraint regime is constitutive: it cannot be subtracted without changing what the system is. This reframes the boundary: it is not, fundamentally, a geometric object but a dynamic, relational constraint structure, and the surface-versus-volume question Chapter 1 held open [Ch1.A7] is, on this reading, mis-posed.

**Ch2.A1 **A boundary is fundamentally a constraint regime - a top-down, constitutive, restrictive-and-enabling structure that reshapes a system”s probability space - not primarily a geometry. Geometry is its scale-specific expression. This is the first appearance of the principle the matrix later reads as a cost-curve: a constraint that closes some paths to open others is already a pricing. (Juarrero; refines Ch1.A6.)

framework_rosetta.title: 2.2 The boundary is a competency horizon
framework_rosetta.body:
Levin gives the constraint regime an operational form and an empirical anchor. An agent”s boundary, in his account, is its cognitive light cone: the spatial and temporal scale over which its network can measure, model, and influence its environment - explicitly not its physical skin. Individuality and cognition are not exclusive to brains; they scale up from the cellular level as independent agents link, via bioelectric signalling, into a larger unified computational boundary that pursues organism-level goals. He demonstrates this with direct intervention: manipulating bioelectric patterns produces altered morphology - eyes or heads in ectopic locations - without genetic edits, strong evidence that pattern and form are not reducible to the genome. With the cognitive light cone the boundary question resolves: Verlinde”s holographic surface, McFadden”s field-volume, and Levin”s light cone are one principle - the boundary as a competency horizon - realised at three scales [Ch1.A7 dissolved].

**Ch2.A2 **The boundary is a competency horizon - the scale at which a system can measure, model, and influence. Holographic surface, EM field-volume, and cognitive light cone are this one principle at three scales. The Ch1 surface-vs-volume question is dissolved, not adjudicated. The matrix”s nested archetype-within-person-within-field reads this nesting. (Levin; closes the Ch1 open question.)

framework_rosetta.title: 2.3 The directional gradient [seeds the matrix”s ought]
framework_rosetta.body:
Both sources carry a directional tilt, and the framework reads it as load-bearing. Juarrero treats differentiated, constraint-governed coherence as the success condition and de-differentiation as failure - a normative tilt toward higher-order organisational form which, read at full strength, amounts to a processual idealism: the “ideal” not as a detached blueprint but as an active principle realised in the dynamics. She pulls back from that language; the framework does not, and logs her stance as a direction-pointer. Levin makes the directional claim explicit: evolution and development are an enormous scaling-up of the cognitive light cone, and he argues openly for teleology in biology, his later work positing a structured Platonic space of patterns as a third causal factor beyond genetics and environment. The framework sits at the committed end of this gradient. This directional tilt - systems pulled toward higher-order integration, toward an ought - is the substrate-and-constraint-scale ancestor of the felt pull the matrix”s supervisor reads at the human scale [FC-3]: the same directionality, not yet felt, not yet priced.

**Ch2.A3 **There is a directional gradient: systems scale their competency horizon toward higher-order, more-differentiated-yet-more-integrated organisation. From the without-perspective teleological (ideal); from the within-perspective identity-relative. Juarrero (suppressed), Levin (hedged, empirical), Hameroff (explicit) mark three commitment-levels - all evidence-of-direction. This gradient becomes the supervisory pull-toward-the-ought once a within-aspect system feels it. (direction-pointer; cf FC-3.)

framework_rosetta.title: 2.4 Ingression is de-isolation; the matrix as maximum-competency finite pattern
framework_rosetta.body:
A sharp objection holds that nothing ingresses: competence is intrinsic to coupling, and isolation adds incompetence - Levin”s own experiments show coupled cellular collectives solve anatomical problems and lose the capacity when severed. Perspective-indexing dissolves the rivalry [F1]. There is no real exterior to the ground, so ingression cannot mean patterns travelling in from elsewhere; it means coupling giving a local region access to a pattern already in the ground but not previously local to it. From the within-perspective a new competence appears - it looks like ingression because the whole now does what the parts could not. From the without-perspective nothing arrived; a boundary formed a local region where the pattern is now expressed, and isolation is precisely what subtracts that expression. The critic describes the without-truth; Levin the within-appearance. This requires one distinction held firmly: a boundary is needed for differentiation toward complexity, and the framework”s higher-order matrix is best read as a maximum-competency finite pattern - the configuration that holds the largest competency horizon while remaining maximally integrated - which must not be collapsed into the absolute ground. The matrix is the maximally differentiated-yet-integrated finite expression; the ground is maximally coupled but undifferentiated, prior to competence. Keep them distinct and the account holds; collapse them and it breaches the epistemic cap that the ground”s without-form is never fully known [the frame”s Q3 guard].

**Ch2.A4 **Ingression (within-view) and de-isolation (without-view) are the same event; the critic”s “isolation adds incompetence” grounds Levin”s “patterns ingress”. A boundary is required for differentiation toward complexity. The higher-order matrix = maximum-competency FINITE pattern, held DISTINCT from the absolute ground. This is why the matrix is an instrument that reads a finite mode, never the ground itself. (F3; standing guard.)

framework_rosetta.title: Arc position
framework_rosetta.body: Chapter 2 is the hinge of the first descent: boundaries now generative [Ch2.A1], operational [Ch2.A2], directional [Ch2.A3], and perspectivally reconciled [Ch2.A4]. The matter/structure descent from Chapter 1 has acquired its organising principle - constraint - and its direction - toward maximum-competency integration. This is the approach to the peak: Chapter 3 takes up consciousness as a universal phenomenon, where the proto-integration claims already flagged meet a substrate-neutral theory of integration directly.

framework_rosetta.title: Chapter 3 - Consciousness as Universal
framework_rosetta.body: *Arc: the macro peak of the micro-macro-micro arc. Descending from the frame: this is where F4 (coherence over maximisation) and F6 (the descent geometry) are earned - the two anchors that license, respectively, the dynamic matrix”s coexisting weightings and the cost-curve”s location of affect at the homeostatic floor. Sources: Albantakis**** ******&****** ****Tononi (IIT 4.0), Seth, Solms, Cogitate, Buckner. Friction-rich chapter.*

framework_rosetta.title: 3.1 Consciousness as intrinsic geometric structure
framework_rosetta.body:
The arc reaches its peak: consciousness treated not as a late product of complexity but as a universal phenomenon to be characterised structurally. Integrated Information Theory supplies the most rigorous available statement of that structure. Its method is axiomatic - self-certifying properties of any experience translated into physical requirements a substrate must satisfy to exist from its own intrinsic perspective - and its central advance is that experience is not a scalar quantity but a geometric structure: the collective geometry of distinctions and their relations. This is the strongest corroboration in the whole compression of the frame”s first commitment, that geometry is foundational and reality relational rather than substantial [Ch1.A1]. Experience, on IIT”s account, simply is the geometry of integrated relations - the framework”s metaphysics stated in formal physics. IIT”s intrinsic perspective also maps cleanly onto the within-perspective [F1], arriving independently at perspective-indexed existence.

**Ch3.A1 **Consciousness is characterised as intrinsic, irreducible cause-effect structure with a geometric form. This formally corroborates the frame”s geometry-first claim (experience = geometry of integrated relations) and aligns IIT”s intrinsic perspective with the within-perspective [F1]. IIT adopted as POINTER; the geometry retained as anchor. (IIT.1-3.)

framework_rosetta.title: 3.2 The exclusion rejection: coherence over maximisation [derives F4]
framework_rosetta.body:
IIT also carries a postulate the framework cannot accept, and rejecting it is what makes the entire dynamic matrix possible. The Exclusion Postulate holds that consciousness exists at exactly one spatio-temporal grain - the complex of maximal integration - and that overlapping or nested complexes are excluded, with the consequence that aggregates of conscious beings have no consciousness of their own. This directly negates the multi-scale nested agency adopted from Levin [Ch2.A2]. Tracing the derivation shows the join is weak: the exclusion axiom, read carefully, supports only the unity of a single experience - that this experience is one and bordered - and says nothing about whether other overlapping systems also have experiences. The leap to across-system exclusivity is carried by an added meta-principle, the principle of maximal existence, introduced to avoid the embarrassment that many overlapping subsystems carry positive integration. It is a stipulation chosen to suppress nested minds, then back-named an axiom; recent reformulations replace maximisation with coherence across scales. The framework performs a located amputation: it keeps the geometry and the partition as a measure of integration strength, and rejects the exclusion clause. This is the frame”s F4, and without it there is no matrix - only a single winner-take-all complex where the framework needs twelve weightings to coexist and nest in one person.

**Ch3.A2 **IIT”s Exclusion Postulate is rejected (kept in log). It rests on the principle of maximal existence - an added stipulation, not deduced, introduced to suppress nested minds. The framework adopts coherence over maximisation: nested/overlapping experiential structures coexist and are convertible. This is the chapter-origin of the frame”s F4 - the permission for the dynamic matrix. (F4; web-grounded; user reflection logged.)

framework_rosetta.title: 3.3 Affect as the within-aspect at the homeostatic floor [derives F6]
framework_rosetta.body:
Solms supplies what IIT”s structural account leaves out: where consciousness comes from and what it is, from within. His thesis, carrying strong neurological evidence - consciousness present in children born without a cortex, abolished by microscopic damage to the brainstem”s periaqueductal grey - is that consciousness originates subcortically and that its foundational form is affect: the felt registration of the organism”s drift from its viable range, broadcast to compel corrective action. Read against IIT this looks like a rival grounding; but the two are not competing at the same level. IIT gives the form of experience (the geometry of integrated distinctions); Solms gives its origin and primary content (felt homeostatic stakes). They are the without-aspect and the within-aspect of one thing [F1]. The geometry requires care, and the framework states it precisely. The apex - maximal coherence, the ground read as the self that Nature is - is the limit at which relation itself collapses: with no difference there is no boundary, no locality, no stakes. It is not a floor to build up from; it is what differentiation descends FROM. Only in the descent, as coherence yields enough to permit difference, does a local property become possible, and a boundary stable enough to define a viability-range. Affect ignites exactly there: at the minimum coherence sufficient for homeostasis - the threshold where the descent has produced a self that can be displaced from its viable range and therefore has something at stake. This is the frame”s F6, and it is the literal foundation of the matrix”s cost-curve: the “at what cost” axis is the pricing of a self that, having descended far enough to have stakes, can be driven from its viable range.

**Ch3.A3 **Affect is the within-aspect of integration at the minimum coherence sufficient for homeostasis - in the differentiated region BELOW the apex. The apex is the relation-collapsing limit, descended-from not built-up-from; affect ignites where descent yields a bounded self with a viability-range. This is the chapter-origin of F6 and the foundation of the matrix”s R-class cost-curve. Solms”s no-cortex evidence separately corroborates F4. (F6.)

framework_rosetta.title: 3.4 The constructed self - model, not fiction
framework_rosetta.body:
If affect is the floor, the rich self of ordinary experience is built upward from it, and Seth and Buckner give the construction. Seth”s claim is that perception is generative and inside-out: the brain issues top-down predictions about the causes of sensory input, and what we call perception is the subset of those predictions reined in by sensory prediction error. The provocative name is “controlled hallucination”, and its weight is in “controlled”: hallucination marks the constructed origin of the content, not its falsity; the control - correction by the world - is what separates veridical perception from the unmoored clinical case. The self is one such controlled construction: a perceptual model the brain builds, world- and body-constrained, homeostatically grounded. Its felt singularity and ownership are properties of the model, not reports on the substrate”s actual boundary. Buckner identifies the organ: the Default Mode Network is not idle rest but a construction system, building internally generated content by recombining stored representations into coherent scenes - the same engine for remembering, imagining, and modelling other minds. The self-model and the models of other minds are built by one engine from the same materials, so the boundary between self and other is itself a construction, permeable at the level of modelling - consistent with the rejection of hard exclusion [F4] and the nesting coupling-interface the frame names [Ch4.A2]. And the construction is dignified rather than deflated: recombining enfolded representation into manifest coherent scenes is, at the neural scale, the same operation the ground performs at the cosmic scale - Bohm”s unfolding [Ch1.A2]. As above, so below.

**Ch3.A4 **The self is a controlled hallucination in Seth”s precise sense: a constructed, world-and-body-constrained MODEL (not illusory; the “control” is correction by the world). Buckner supplies the mechanism: DMN constructive scene-building, one engine for memory, prospection, theory-of-mind - so the self/other boundary is constructed and permeable. (Seth.1,3,4; Buckner.1,2.)

**Ch3.A5 **As above, so below: DMN scene-building is the neural-scale instance of Bohm”s unfold/enfold [Ch1.A2]. The constructed self is a local recurrence of the ground”s constructive activity - which dignifies “constructed” as real-as-a-model, not illusion. The Abstract hardware group (Sage, Artist) reads this DMN construction at the archetype scale. (Buckner.2,4.)

framework_rosetta.title: 3.5 The equivocal field, and what the peak settles
framework_rosetta.body:
The chapter”s empirical capstone is the Cogitate Consortium”s adversarial test: competing camps committed in advance to distinguishing predictions, executed by a neutral party across three neuroimaging modalities on more than two hundred and fifty subjects. Both leading theories failed their primary predictions - IIT”s sustained posterior gamma was transient, the global-workspace late prefrontal ignition was absent - leaving the field equivocal. This matters in three measured ways. The adversarial method is the framework”s own falsification posture realised in consciousness science. The failure empirically corroborates treating IIT as a pointer rather than a load-bearing source - though with discipline: what failed is IIT”s linking hypothesis, not its geometry axiom, and the failure of IIT”s cortical prediction is consistent with the affective-floor account by absence, not positive confirmation. And the equivocal result supports holding the self-question open rather than closing it.

**Ch3.A6 **The field is empirically equivocal: both IIT and the global-workspace theory failed their preregistered predictions (Cogitate). This corroborates IIT-as-pointer (linking hypothesis failed, geometry axiom untouched), instantiates the framework”s adversarial-falsification posture, and supports holding the multiplicity question open. (Cogitate.1,3,4,5.)

framework_rosetta.title: Arc position
framework_rosetta.body: Chapter 3 is the summit: consciousness treated as universal, characterised as geometric form [Ch3.A1], grounded as affect at the homeostatic floor [Ch3.A3 = F6], constructed upward as the self-model [Ch3.A4-A5], located in an open empirical field [Ch3.A6]. The exclusion rejection [Ch3.A2 = F4] and the descent-from-apex geometry are the chapter”s load-bearing additions - the two anchors that license the dynamic matrix and its cost-curve. From here the arc turns back down into particularity - the second micro - beginning with the engine that runs the constructed, predicting, homeostatically-driven mind: Chapter 4, active inference and the free-energy principle.

framework_rosetta.title: Chapter 4 - The Engine: Prediction, Free Energy, and the Felt Pull Toward the Ought
framework_rosetta.body: *Arc: the first turn of the second descent into particularity; the spine chapter, most cross-referenced. Descending from the frame: FC-3 (affect = felt pull toward the ought) and Ch4.A2 (the boundary as nesting Markov blanket) are earned here - the two anchors that define the matrix”s supervisory mechanism and its shared-substrate nesting. Sources: Friston, Ramstead/Badcock/Friston, Carhart-Harris (Entropic), Carhart-Harris**** ******&****** ****Friston (REBUS).*

framework_rosetta.title: 4.1 The engine: minimising free energy
framework_rosetta.body:
With the peak passed, the arc turns back down into particularity, and the first thing it meets is the engine that runs the mind characterised in Chapter 3. Friston”s free-energy principle states it in its most general form: any adaptive system is driven to minimise free energy - equivalently, to minimise prediction error, the discrepancy between what it expects and what it senses. It does this two ways: by updating its internal model to match the world, or by acting on the world to make it match the model. Ramstead, Badcock and Friston extend this from brains to persistence as such: anything that continues to exist rather than dissipating must behave as if performing inference to minimise free energy. This is the engine the previous chapter”s threads were already running on - Seth”s controlled hallucination is its perceptual face [Ch3.A4], Solms”s affect its homeostatic face [Ch3.A3]. The matrix”s later claim that personality is the tuning-configuration of a gap-closing engine [MASTER-CONV] is the claim that an archetype is a characteristic bias on exactly this machine.

**Ch4.A1 **The engine of the finite mode is free-energy minimisation: an adaptive system continuously minimises the divergence between expected and actual states, by updating its model or acting on the world. Persistence itself requires it. This is the engine an archetype tunes [MASTER-CONV]. (Friston.1,2,4; RBF.1,4.)

framework_rosetta.title: 4.2 The boundary, formalised: the Markov blanket [derives Ch4.A2]
framework_rosetta.body:
To minimise free energy a system must have an inside distinct from an outside - and the boundary that makes this so is a Markov blanket: a statistical partition such that internal states are conditionally independent of external states, with all influence passing through sensory states (inputs) and active states (outputs). This is not a new boundary but the formal-statistical version of the one already built: the competency horizon of Chapter 2 [Ch2.A2], the locality-maker of Chapter 1 [Ch1.A6], the homeostatic boundary of Chapter 3 [Ch3.A3]. Three independent vocabularies converge on one object. And the blanket is nested and scale-invariant: a Markov blanket of Markov blankets, cell within organism within society. This is the frame”s nesting coupling-interface, and it is precisely what lets the matrix read an archetype as nested within a person within a social field, and two archetypes as sharing a hardware substrate without being sealed kinds - the discipline being exact: a Markov blanket is the boundary of a persisting system, not necessarily of an experiencer, so nested systems coexisting does not by itself establish nested experiencers; that question stays open [Q5-inter].

**Ch4.A2 **The boundary is formally a Markov blanket (sensory in, active out), nested and scale-invariant. This formalises - does not compete with - the competency horizon [Ch2.A2], locality [Ch1.A6], and the homeostatic boundary [F6]. Nested blankets corroborate F4”s exclusion-rejection - but show nested SYSTEMS, not nested experiencers. This is the chapter-origin of the frame”s boundary anchor and the reason archetypes share substrate without sealing. (Friston.3; RBF.3.)

framework_rosetta.title: 4.3 Affect as the felt pull toward the ought [derives FC-3 - the supervisor”s definition]
framework_rosetta.body:
The free-energy principle has a famous exposed edge - the dark-room problem. If a system only minimises surprise, it should retreat to a dark, silent, perfectly predictable room; yet organisms seek novelty and explore. The entropic-brain data sharpen this: the low-entropy pole, where priors are rigid and the repertoire narrow, is not optimal but pathological - the territory of rumination, obsession, addiction, depression. Pure minimisation is not the healthy attractor; a counter-pressure exists. What that counter-pressure is, the framework states by reframing what affect is. Affect is the valenced interoceptive reading of the gap between the system”s actual state and its ought-state - Friston”s narrow window of survivable states. It is not a product of cortical reorganisation nor a driver standing outside the loop; it is the input to the loop, the felt measurement of distance-from-ideal. But in a system with a within-aspect - that feels the gap rather than merely registering an error term - that reading becomes a pull: the felt gap moves the organism toward the ought. This is the frame”s FC-3, and it is the literal definition of the matrix”s supervisor: the archetype in its dynamic sense is the characteristic direction and price of a configuration”s felt pull toward its ought. The directional gradient of Chapter 2 [Ch2.A3] is, on this account, the system pulled toward its ought, now felt; as above, so below, the local ought a system feels its way toward is the local instance of the apex ideaal.

**Ch4.A3 **Affect is the valenced interoceptive reading of the gap between is-state and ought-state. In a within-aspect system the reading becomes a PULL toward the ought - affect-as-driver, deriving from the felt pull, not from set-point revisability. The dark-room data (low-entropy pole pathological) confirm a counter-pressure to pure minimisation. This is the chapter-origin of FC-3 and the definition the supervisory mechanism reads. (FC-3 resolved, FC-4 dissolved; cf Ch3.A3, Ch2.A3.)

framework_rosetta.title: 4.4 Entropy, precision, and the dissolvable self
framework_rosetta.body:
The entropic-brain and REBUS work give the engine its variable and its tuning. Conscious states lie on an entropy spectrum - the diversity of the brain”s spontaneous repertoire - and the Default Mode Network sits at the apex of the predictive hierarchy as the substrate of the ego, supplying the high-level, long-timescale priors that constrain everything below. This is the same DMN Chapter 3 identified as the construction-engine of the self [Ch3.A5]: construction and constraint are one operation. Crucially the structure is tunable. Reducing the precision of those priors - pharmacologically, through serotonergic agonism - flattens the hierarchy, releases the lower levels, raises entropy, and attenuates the ego: a partial reverse-descent. The self proves precision-dependent and dissolvable, intervention-grade evidence that it is constructed rather than given. The matrix”s later treatment of the Abstract group”s cost-curve - the DMN-Deep inward-spiral that seals - is this same precision-structure read at the archetype scale.

**Ch4.A4 **Consciousness varies along an entropy spectrum; the DMN/ego supplies the high-precision priors that constrain it. Construction [Buckner] and constraint [EBH] are one operation. Lowering prior precision flattens the hierarchy and dissolves the ego - a partial reverse-descent - evidence the self is constructed and variable. (EBH.1-4; REBUS.1-3; cf Ch3.A4.)

framework_rosetta.title: 4.5 The failure taxonomy [the root of every cost-curve]
framework_rosetta.body:
Finally the engine chapter resolves the single “collapse” seen in earlier chapters into three distinct, data-distinguished failure modes - the abstract root of every hardware group”s R-class cost-curve. Blanket dissolution is the boundary itself failing - conditional independence between inside and outside breaks down and the system structurally collapses (cell lysis, death); terminal and scale-invariant, the general form of de-differentiation. Criticality-mistuning is the system mis-tuning its entropy while the boundary holds - too rigid or too chaotic - and is in principle recoverable. High-precision rigidity is the specific low-entropy sub-type, trapped defending maladaptive priors against contradictory evidence - the territory of treatment-resistant depression, addiction, compulsion. When the matrix later prices each group”s collapse differently - the Ruling group”s rigidity, the Chaos group”s dissolution into incoherence, the Agency group”s sudden depletion - it is distributing these three modes across the wheel.

**Ch4.A5 **Three data-distinguished failure modes: blanket dissolution (boundary fails; terminal; the general form of de-differentiation); criticality-mistuning (mis-tuned entropy, intact boundary; recoverable); high-precision rigidity (trapped on maladaptive priors; depression/OCD/addiction). The R-class cost-curves distribute these across the twelve archetypes. (RBF.5; EBH.6; REBUS.4.)

**Ch4.A5-EXT (Component-D grounding cycle; human-ratified). Five abstract failure-modes, six group-instantiations, carved at originating mechanism.** The matrix’s D5 collapse layer, read across all twelve archetypes, resolves the three-mode root into **five abstract failure-modes**, each on an independently-attested CNS mechanism, distributed as **six group-instantiations**. The carve is made at **originating mechanism**, not terminal state — several modes converge downstream (e.g. valence-inversion terminates in dopamine-depletion) but dissociate at origin, and the taxonomy carves where they dissociate.

- **Rigidity-lock** (CEN / Ruling) — control over-tightens; active limbic suppression; the Arnsten prefrontal-switch takes dlPFC offline under uncontrollable stress, then synaptic depletion. Boundary holds. (= high-precision rigidity.)

- **Dissolution** (SN + Limbic — *one abstract mode, two direction-instantiations*): boundary fails **outward into incoherence** (SN/Chaos — salience-network destabilisation, supercritical) or **inward into the other** (Limbic/Relational — attachment-system over-bonding, self-other fusion). Same abstract shape, two substrates and directions.

- **Dissociation / boundary-over-holding** (DMN / Abstract) — prefrontal over-suppression seals the interior; insula-DMN decoupling; derealisation. Boundary *over*-holds (the inverse topology of dissolution). Mechanism: **cortico-limbic disconnection** (Sierra & Berrios 1998), independent of polyvagal — see Ch7.A5 re-grounding.

- **Drive/energy depletion** (Motor / Agency) — BAS approach-drive over-mobilises (strain read as challenge, drive escalates), cost is suppressed, then sudden effort/vigour exhaustion. Origin: effort over-mobilisation (dissociable from incentive deficit — Le Heron 2018).

- **Valence-inversion collapse** (LC-NE / Seeker) — the appetitive system inverts to aversive (amygdala-LC tonic-shift; LHb anti-reward takeover); reward stops pulling, the world acquires aversive sign. The valence-sign-flip is causally upstream of the downstream dopamine-depletion it recruits — a distinct mode, not a depletion with a sign.

**Mode-relations (carried, not suppressed):** mode-5 (valence-inversion) *recruits* mode-4 (depletion) downstream via LHb→RMTg→dopamine-suppression — directional (valence-collapse can terminate in depletion; depletion does not require valence-inversion). The two are distinct at origin, coupled at terminal; the engine needs the relation because both look anhedonic at terminal.

**Mechanism-axes (the six transforms ground on four shared control-parameters, each with poles/instantiations):** (i) **cortico-limbic coupling** — DMN effective-over-suppression (seal) ↔ Limbic ineffective-coupling-under-flooding (dissolve); (ii) **criticality tuning** — CEN over-constrained/rigid ↔ SN under-constrained/fluid (the rigid-fluid-misswitch axis, Ch5.A5); (iii) **effort/drive mobilisation** — Motor (over-mobilise→exhaust; no anchored opposite pole); (iv) **valuation/incentive** — LC-NE (approach→valence-inversion; no anchored opposite pole). Two axes are clean two-pole pairs; two are single-pole, linked to each other only by the mode-5→4 terminal convergence. The failure-space has dimensions, not six unrelated curves. *(Construction rule applied — see Ch4.A5-RULE.)*

**Ch4.A5-RULE (schema-construction method; human-ratified, with M1/M2). Carve at originating mechanism; represent downstream convergence as relations.** When building a failure-mode or cell-type taxonomy, classify by the originating mechanism, not the terminal state or surface value-band. Where distinct modes converge downstream (shared terminal, shared component, shared value-band), represent the convergence as an explicit *relation* between modes, never by merging them. This is M1 (typing discipline) extended to schema construction; it governs the D1–D4 enrichment to come as it governed D5. *Falsifier: a case where carving at origin produces a demonstrably worse taxonomy than carving at terminal retires the rule.*

framework_rosetta.title: Arc position
framework_rosetta.body: Chapter 4 is the first turn of the second micro: it supplies the engine [Ch4.A1], formalises the boundary as the nesting Markov blanket [Ch4.A2], settles affect”s causal role as the felt pull toward the ought [Ch4.A3 = FC-3], and clarifies how the system fails [Ch4.A5]. The engine now needs its hardware. Chapter 5 takes up the brain”s network architecture - the triple network - where the six hardware groups the matrix reads first acquire their cold-data substrate.

framework_rosetta.title: Chapter 5 - The Hardware: Network Architecture
framework_rosetta.body: *Arc: the configured-individual scale begins in earnest. Descending from the engine [Ch4]: this chapter gives the engine its hardware, and it is the scale at which the matrix”s six hardware groups are seated. The cold data of those groups - their networks, C-directions, and cost-curves - threads in here as the Nature-layer substrate the matrix reads. Sources: Menon, Bassett, Christoff.*

framework_rosetta.title: 5.1 The triple-network architecture [seats the six hardware groups]
framework_rosetta.body:
The engine of Chapter 4 needs hardware, and the hardware is a small set of large-scale networks in dynamic competition. Menon”s triple-network model gives the organising structure: cognitive mode is set by a functional competition between the externally-focused Central Executive Network and the internally-focused Default Mode Network, coordinated by a third system, the Salience Network. The three sources describe one object at three grains - Menon the architecture, Bassett”s flexible hubs the physical nodes that change affiliation, Christoff”s constraint-gated transitions the functional dynamics. This is the substrate on which the matrix”s six hardware groups are built, and the linkage is direct and inline: the Ruling group (Judge, Ruler) is seated on the CEN/dlPFC [its network is this chapter”s executive network]; the Abstract group (Sage, Artist) on the DMN [the construction-engine of Ch3.A5 and the ego-priors of Ch4.A4]; the Chaos group (Outlaw, Trickster) on the Salience Network [this chapter”s switch]. The remaining three groups - Agency on motor/BAS/striatal, Seeker on LC-NE/dopaminergic, Relational on limbic/vagal - are seated on systems Chapter 5 will note the triple network under-weights and Chapters 7 and 8 supply. Each group”s cold data resolves against this architecture: when the matrix reads “Ruler weights Coordination near ceiling”, the meaning is a CEN-seated configuration biasing the gap-closing engine toward executive control [MASTER-CONV + ANTI-ESS], not a label.

**Ch5.A1 **The triple-network architecture (CEN, DMN, Salience) is the organising hardware of large-scale cognition. Menon”s architecture, Bassett”s flexible hubs, and Christoff”s constraint-gated thought are one structure at three grains. Three of the six matrix hardware groups (Ruling/CEN, Abstract/DMN, Chaos/SN) are seated directly here; the other three on systems Ch7/Ch8 supply. (Menon.1,3; Bassett.3; Christoff.2.)

framework_rosetta.title: 5.2 Salience-driven switching
framework_rosetta.body:
What coordinates the competition is the Salience Network, anchored in the anterior insula and dorsal anterior cingulate. It monitors internal and external events for relevance and switches network dominance - activating the task-relevant network while modulating down the other. This gives the DMN-versus-attention anticorrelation an active controller, and it is functional opposition with a switch, not mechanical annihilation [coheres F4]: the non-dominant network is suppressed contextually and recovers when salience shifts. And the switch is not neutral: the anterior insula is the brain”s principal interoceptive hub, so salience is read in significant part from the body - the switch between internal and external cognitive modes is affect-driven. This is why the matrix seats the supervisory mechanism partly in the dorsal anterior cingulate [the frame”s supervisor seat]: the dACC sits in this switch, and the Chaos group, seated on the Salience Network, therefore sits unusually close to the supervisory seat itself - the cold-data reason the matrix reads Chaos as the volatile, self-amplifying setting of the supervisor.

**Ch5.A2 **The Salience Network (anterior insula/dACC) is the switch coordinating DMN-CEN dominance - functional opposition with a controller, not annihilation [coheres F4]. Because the insula is interoceptive, the switch is salience/affect-driven. The dACC switch-seat is why the matrix locates the supervisor partly here and reads the Chaos group (SN-seated) as sitting closest to the supervisory seat. (Menon.2,4; cf Buckner.4.)

framework_rosetta.title: 5.3 Dynamic reconfiguration: static form, dynamic distribution
framework_rosetta.body:
Bassett”s work supplies the temporal character of this hardware and a clean empirical instance of one of the framework”s founding commitments. The brain”s functional topology is not a fixed hub-and-spoke arrangement; it constantly decouples and rewires on a subsecond-to-minute timescale according to task and learning state. Yet this reconfiguration runs on fixed anatomical wiring, and the freedom to reconfigure is anatomically differentiated: flexible hubs in association cortex change their affiliations, while sensory regions stay stable. This is static form holding a dynamic distribution - realised and spatially split at the network scale. It is also the empirical face of the dynamic-matrix rule [ANTI-ESS]: the wiring is fixed, the affiliations flow - exactly as the matrix holds all twelve archetypes to have fixed default access to all twelve functions while the weighting flows. Learning is the physical exploration of network configurations, broad and expensive early, then narrowed to efficient exploitation - the same entropy-to-constraint movement [Ch4.A4] now at the timescale of learning.

**Ch5.A3 **The brain”s functional topology dynamically reconfigures on fixed anatomical wiring; the static/dynamic split is spatial (stable sensory form, flexible associative hubs). This anchors the framework”s static-form/dynamic-distribution commitment empirically and is the network-scale face of ANTI-ESS (fixed access, flowing weighting). Explore-exploit is the learning-time face of the one entropy-constraint axis. (Bassett.1,2,3,5.)

framework_rosetta.title: 5.4 Cortical networks above the affective floor
framework_rosetta.body:
Christoff completes the functional picture and ties the chapter to the threads from the peak. Mind-wandering is not defined by content but by the relaxation of constraints on thought transitions, gated by two orthogonal systems: a deliberate top-down constraint via the executive network, and an automatic affective constraint - the “stickiness” of emotionally weighted material - via the salience system. Maximum spontaneous generativity arrives only when both decay. And Menon”s own acknowledged limit is that the triple-network model is cortical and under-weights the subcortical systems that drive arousal and motivation - which is exactly the brainstem affective floor located at the peak [Ch3.A3]. The two compose along the descent: the triple network is the high-differentiation cortical layer of conception and control, sitting above and switched by salience read from the subcortical floor of feeling. Menon”s gap is not a flaw but the place where this chapter”s hardware meets the previous chapter”s ground - and the place where the matrix”s other three hardware groups (Agency, Seeker, Relational), seated on subcortical/autonomic systems, find their substrate in Chapters 7 and 8.

**Ch5.A4 **The triple network is the high-differentiation CORTICAL layer; Menon”s acknowledged subcortical gap is filled by the Solms affective floor [F6] - they compose along the descent. This is why three matrix hardware groups are cortical-seated (Ruling, Abstract, Chaos) and three subcortical/autonomic-seated (Agency, Seeker, Relational). (Menon.5; Christoff.2,3.)

framework_rosetta.title: 5.5 Failure at the network level
framework_rosetta.body:
Each source describes how the hardware fails, and together they complete the failure taxonomy begun in the engine chapter. The robust finding is a structural axis: networks can be over-constrained and rigid - unable to decouple, the sticky-rumination pole - or under-constrained and fluid - unable to stabilise, the distractible pole - with a third mode of mis-switching, in which the salience network assigns dominance wrongly (aberrant salience). The clinical labelling is source-variable and flagged simplified. This rigid-fluid-misswitch axis is the network-scale template the matrix”s cost-curves specialise: the Ruling group”s U-curve sits at the rigid pole, the Chaos group”s inverted curve at the mis-switching/fluid pole, each a specific inhabitation of this one axis [cf Ch4.A5].

**Ch5.A5 **Network-level failure completes the taxonomy as a structural axis: over-constraint/rigidity - under-constraint/fluidity, plus mis-switching (aberrant salience). Robust across sources; clinical labels source-variable. The matrix”s R-class cost-curves specialise this axis per group. (Menon.5; Bassett.6; Christoff.5; cf Ch4.A5.)

framework_rosetta.title: Arc position
framework_rosetta.body: Chapter 5 gives the engine its hardware: a small set of networks [Ch5.A1] switched by salience read from the body [Ch5.A2], reconfiguring dynamically on fixed wiring [Ch5.A3], seated as the cortical conception-layer above the affective floor [Ch5.A4], failing along a structural axis [Ch5.A5] - and it seats three of the matrix”s six hardware groups directly while pointing the other three forward. The architecture is spatial; what it lacks is time. Chapter 6 supplies the temporal organisation - oscillations and cross-frequency coupling.

framework_rosetta.title: Chapter 6 - Timing: Oscillations and Coupling
framework_rosetta.body: *Arc: inside the hardware - the temporal dimension that binds network states. Descending from Ch5: the spatial architecture acquires its timing. The frame”s scale-recurrence [SCALE-REC] gains a temporal instance here (nesting in time as in space). Sources: Buzsaki (The Brain from Inside Out), Buzsaki**** ******&****** ****Wang.*

framework_rosetta.title: 6.1 Inside-out: the engine at the oscillatory level
framework_rosetta.body:
The network architecture of Chapter 5 is spatial; it says which systems compete and switch, but not how that competition is timed. Buzsaki supplies the temporal substrate and confirms the engine of Chapter 4 from a new direction. His inside-out brain is not a passive stimulus-driven machine but an active, endogenous generator of predictions and action plans tested against the world; sensory input does not command behaviour, it modulates and corrects pre-existing self-generated models. This is the active-inference engine [Ch4.A1] stated in neurophysiology, and the controlled-hallucination account [Ch3.A4] stated in oscillations: inside-out, active inference, and controlled hallucination are three vocabularies for one engine. A hard datum underwrites it - purely sensory cortex occupies only a small fraction of neural real estate, the bulk sustaining internal forward models - grounding the framework”s generative, constructed self in cortical economics. This also touches the parked question of feedforward versus recurrent architecture: biological consciousness in fact runs on recurrent architecture, consistent with the integration theory”s claim, but this does not settle whether a feedforward artificial system is therefore unconscious - that verdict is deferred to the coda [FC2-CAP].

**Ch6.A1 **The inside-out brain - endogenous prediction tested against input - is the active-inference engine [Ch4.A1] at the oscillatory level, and re-meets Seth”s inside-out perception. Most of cortex sustains internal models, grounding the generative self. Biological consciousness is recurrent; the feedforward/AI verdict is deferred to Ch12 [FC2-CAP]. (Buzsaki.1,2,3.)

framework_rosetta.title: 6.2 Cross-frequency coupling: the architecture in time
framework_rosetta.body:
Buzsaki and Wang give the mechanism. Fast local gamma rhythms open fine-grained temporal windows that bind information within a circuit but cannot carry it efficiently across long distances. The brain solves this with cross-frequency coupling - specifically phase-amplitude coupling - in which the slow phase of a long-range rhythm such as theta modulates and groups the amplitude packets of fast gamma. Slow rhythms coordinate distant regions; fast rhythms bind locally; the slow continually groups the fast. This is the temporal organisation the spatial architecture of Chapter 5 lacked: the triple network says which network dominates [Ch5.A1]; cross-frequency coupling says how dominance and binding are timed. The seam between spatial architecture and temporal organisation closes here.

**Ch6.A2 **Cross-frequency (phase-amplitude) coupling organises the spatial architecture in time: slow long-range rhythms coordinate distant regions and group fast local gamma packets that bind within regions. This closes the Ch5-Ch6 seam. (BuzWang.1,2,4; cf Ch5.A1.)

framework_rosetta.title: 6.3 Nesting recurs in time as in space
framework_rosetta.body:
The form of cross-frequency coupling is the framework”s signature pattern appearing in a new dimension. Phase-amplitude coupling is fast rhythms nested within slow rhythms - a hierarchical, multi-scale nesting in time. The framework already carries nesting at the spatial-boundary scale: the nested Markov blankets of the engine chapter [Ch4.A2], a blanket within a blanket from cell to organism. Here the same nested hierarchy appears in the time domain, gamma within theta within delta. The frame”s scale-recurrence [SCALE-REC] gains a temporal instance: the one coherent pattern - hierarchy of bounded units within bounded units - organises time as it organises space.

**Ch6.A3 **Phase-amplitude coupling (fast-within-slow rhythms) is the temporal instance of the framework”s nesting pattern - the same nested hierarchy as the spatial nested Markov blankets [Ch4.A2], now in time. Scale-recurrence holds across dimensions [SCALE-REC]. (BuzWang.2,4; cf Ch4.A2.)

framework_rosetta.title: 6.4 Failure at the timing scale
framework_rosetta.body:
The timing layer fails in two ways that map onto the taxonomy already built. When the endogenous model loses its tether to sensory feedback, prediction runs unconstrained and is circulated as reality - hallucination and psychosis - the high-entropy direction of the criticality axis [Ch4.A5]. And when the synchronisation that generates the rhythms breaks down, cross-frequency coupling collapses, information can no longer be cleanly packeted across regions, and cognition fragments - temporal de-coordination, the timing-scale form of coherence-loss. Both are recorded as markers rather than clean causal mechanisms.

**Ch6.A4 **Two timing-scale failures: unconstrained prediction (model loses the sensory tether - hallucination; high-entropy direction) and desynchronisation (cross-frequency coupling collapses - fragmentation). Both map to the existing taxonomy [Ch4.A5, Ch5.A5]. (Buzsaki.5; BuzWang.5.)

framework_rosetta.title: Arc position
framework_rosetta.body: Chapter 6 completes the how of the machinery: the engine [Ch4] realised in recurrent oscillatory generation, the spatial architecture [Ch5] coordinated in time by cross-frequency coupling, the nesting pattern shown to recur in time [SCALE-REC]. What remains is the tuning - the chemical and autonomic systems that set the gain, arousal, and state. Chapter 7 takes up neuromodulation and autonomic regulation, where the matrix”s Seeker and Relational groups find their substrate.

framework_rosetta.title: Chapter 7 - Modulation: Arousal, Gain, and the Autonomic Baseline
framework_rosetta.body: *Arc: the dynamic baseline shaping engine, hardware, and timing. Descending from the engine”s precision knob [Ch4.A4]: here it gets its chemistry. Two of the matrix”s six hardware groups are seated here - Seeker on LC-NE/dopaminergic, Relational on limbic/vagal - and their cold data threads in inline. Sources: Aston-Jones**** ******&****** ****Cohen, Porges.*

framework_rosetta.title: 7.1 The gain knob [seats the Seeker group]
framework_rosetta.body:
Engine, hardware, and timing all presuppose a setting - a level of responsiveness, an arousal state. Aston-Jones and Cohen supply that knob. The locus-coeruleus norepinephrine system is not a generic arousal dial but a controller of the tradeoff between exploiting a known good and exploring for alternatives, working by modulating gain: the slope of the input-output function of cortical neurons. In phasic mode - a low baseline punctuated by bursts time-locked to relevant targets - it multiplicatively boosts already-active representations, sharpening signal against noise for exploitation. When task value falls, it shifts to tonic mode - a sustained elevated baseline - raising gain everywhere, amplifying distractors and novelties, mechanically pushing the organism to explore. This is, in neuromodulatory hardware, the precision-weighting the engine chapter relied on [Ch4.A4]. It is also the substrate of the matrix”s Seeker group (Innocent, Explorer): when the matrix reads the Seeker group as the configuration that loosens the supervisory pull toward novel input at the price of groundedness, the cold-data meaning is an LC-NE system biased toward tonic exploratory gain - high openness to input, low prior-precision [ANTI-ESS reads this as a weighting, not a kind].

**Ch7.A1 **LC-NE modulates cortical gain, implementing precision-weighting neuromodulatorily: phasic = high precision for exploitation, tonic = flattened precision for exploration.
