framework_rosetta.title: Hardware Group 2 - Chaos (Salience Network) - Outlaw, Trickster
HARDWARE GROUP 2 — THE CHAOS GROUP
framework_rosetta.body:
*Disruption Cluster · Salience Network · Entropic Brain**** ******&****** ****Network Kinematics*

Archetypes: Outlaw (6) · Trickster (7) | R-class: SN-Entropic | Green hardware-anchor arc (bottom of wheel) | v1 · 2026-06-05

Document scope. Cold-data hardware substrate for the two archetypes anchored on the Salience Network. PRIMARY: shared neurobiology, biochemistry, the R-class cost-curve, falsification — the fixed substrate every Component B/C/D derivation for Outlaw and Trickster reads from. SECONDARY: the supervisory signature — how this network sets the push/pull toward what-ought-to-be, at what cost. The 12 functions are the shared wheel; Supervision is not among them — it is the supervisory mechanism itself (archetype-as-dynamic-shaping). This group is the hardware opposition to the Ruling group (the CEN–SN tetrad, where red and purple coincide — an entropic-SN state-opposition, C3): where Ruling builds and holds structure, Chaos detects and breaks it. All corpus data extracted from the Archetype folder + web audit (2020–2026).

framework_rosetta.title: 2 — Group-Anchor Specification (C-engine direction — non-negotiable)
framework_rosetta.body:

Per Bassett, the network rapidly reconfigures its community structure (high flexibility/kinematics). Per Menon, the SN is the switchboard: it detects salient events and forces the toggle out of whichever network is running. The Chaos system uses this to break rigid frames rather than maintain them. |
| [Hardware] | Injects SN dominance, raised neural entropy, and high network-reconfiguration flexibility. |
| [Behavior] | Acts as a dis-inhibitory disruptor. Forces the Main to break fixed frames, surface what is being avoided, and tolerate (even seek) the critical edge where reorganisation becomes possible. |
| [Effect — C-direction] | INCREASES: Modulation (flexibility mode), Perception, Abstraction (frame-shifting). DECREASES: Coordination, rigid Attention, Differentiation-rigidity. |

framework_rosetta.title: 7 — The R-class Cost-Curve (SN-Entropic) — the ‘at what cost’ axis
framework_rosetta.body:
First-class cold data: half the supervisor’s definition (push/pull toward ought, at what cost). The SN-Entropic curve is the inverse of CEN-Structural — it does not degrade FROM order, it lives near the critical edge and degrades INTO nihilism.

| D-state | Expression | Mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Coherent baseline | VOLATILE / near critical edge | Lives closer to the entropic edge than other classes; baseline is dynamic, not still. Healthy expression: catalytic disruption, vital humour, frame-breaking insight. |
| D2 Strained | RISES into engagement | Unlike CEN (which masks D2), the SN-Entropic class becomes MORE activated under disruption — strain is fuel. The rebel sharpens; the jester quickens. |
| D3 Entrenched | DECOUPLING deepens | SN decouples further from reflective DMN. Outlaw → destructive cynicism, addiction to chaos (leaves only ash). Trickster → cruelty, the ‘sad clown’, toxic nihilism where everything is a joke and real connection dies. |
| D4 Acute dysregulation | SHARP — over-critical/supercritical | Entropy past the useful edge: incoherence, impulsive destruction, identity-fragmentation. The disruption no longer serves reorganisation. |
| D5 Collapse | Burnout / nihilistic void | Outlaw: war-mode that cannot stop, scorched earth. Trickster: collapse of the mask, the despair the humour was deflecting. Recovery cue: a structure worth building (the Ruler shadow). |

**Curve shape: **Inverted vs CEN — volatile/edge D1, rising D2 (strain is fuel), deepening decoupling at D3, sharp supercritical D4–D5. The class that performs BEST under acute disruption and WORST in enforced stasis. Recovery cue: a worthwhile structure to build (imports the Ruling anchor).

framework_rosetta.title: 10 — Supervisory Signature — How the SN Sets the Push/Pull
framework_rosetta.body:
Secondary layer. The supervisory mechanism (dACC-seated value/control + BST anticipatory cost) is set by this group’s hardware as follows. Note: the dACC is itself part of the Salience Network — so the Chaos group sits unusually close to the supervisory seat, which is why its push/pull is volatile and self-amplifying.

**Toward what ought (the pull): **Disruption / truth-through-breaking. The SN push/pull pulls the configuration AWAY from any frame that has gone rigid — toward the critical edge where reorganisation is possible. The ought is the system broken open and made honest. dACC computes high incentive-value for salient incongruity (hypocrisy, stagnation).

**At what cost (the price): **Coherence. The cost is the loss of stable structure — high-entropy failure family (the dissolved pole of the permeability axis), the mirror of the Ruling group’s petrification. BST prices stasis/complicity as the threat; the supervisor pays by decoupling from the reflective DMN and converting tension directly into disruptive action.

**Outlaw vs Trickster (two signatures, one substrate): **Outlaw sets the push/pull toward confrontational system-breaking (Modulation/dis-inhibition anchor) — pulls toward exposed power, prices complicity as betrayal, externalises as aggression. Trickster sets it toward playful frame-dissolution (Perception anchor) — pulls toward punctured ego/absurdity revealed, prices earnest vulnerability as danger, deflects via humour. Same SN-Entropic cost-curve; different anchor-vector.

*Empirical seat: the SN switchboard (anterior insula + dACC) toggles DMN↔CEN — confirmed by its breakdown in schizophrenia (2021) and insomnia hyperarousal (2026). Brain criticality is clinically relevant (2020). The Chaos group runs the supervisory engine at maximum entropy-tolerance, near the critical edge.*

framework_rosetta.title: Hardware Group 3 - Agency (Motor / BAS / Striatal) - Magician, Hero
HARDWARE GROUP 3 — THE AGENCY GROUP
framework_rosetta.body:
*Action Cluster · Motor / BAS / Striatal · Approach Motivation**** ******&****** ****Willpower*

Archetypes: Magician (10) · Hero (11) | R-class: Motor-Kinetic | Green hardware-anchor arc (upper-left of wheel) | v1 · 2026-06-05

Document scope. Cold-data hardware substrate for the two archetypes anchored on the motor / behavioural-activation / striatal-dopamine system. PRIMARY: shared neurobiology, biochemistry, the R-class cost-curve, falsification — the fixed substrate every Component B/C/D derivation for Magician and Hero reads from. SECONDARY: the supervisory signature — how this network sets the push/pull toward what-ought-to-be, at what cost. The 12 functions are the shared wheel; Supervision is not among them — it is the supervisory mechanism itself (archetype-as-dynamic-shaping). This group is the engine of enacted will: it does not analyse or feel the ought, it MOVES the world toward it. All corpus data extracted from the Archetype folder + web audit (2020–2026).

framework_rosetta.body:

Agency external, Seeker internal: the shadow crosses orientation. Agency reinforces the Seeker; integration restores grounding rather than importing from a hardware opposite. |

framework_rosetta.title: 2 — Group-Anchor Specification (C-engine direction — non-negotiable)
framework_rosetta.body:
The load-bearing cold datum. When an Agency archetype supports another Main, it injects this substrate and modulates the Main’s functions in these directions. Sign-direction fixed by biology; magnitude is author judgment.

| Element | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| The concept | Per Gray’s BAS, approach behaviour is driven by sensitivity to reward/non-punishment, engaging striatal dopamine to pursue goals. Per Panksepp, the SEEKING system supplies the appetitive ‘go’ drive. The Agency system binds testosterone and dopamine to the overcoming of resistance — converting intention directly into enacted change in the world. It does not deliberate (CEN) or incubate (DMN); it moves. |
| [Hardware] | Injects BAS/striatal approach-drive and motor-execution capacity. |
| [Behavior] | Acts as an action-forcing vector. Forces the Main to convert plans into movement, pursue the goal against resistance, and prioritise tangible outcome over reflection or analysis. |
| [Effect — C-direction] | INCREASES: Motion, Realisation, Coordination (action-coordination). DECREASES: Abstraction (passive), Perception (passive intake). |

framework_rosetta.title: 3 — The 12-Function Wheel — Agency Cluster Reading
framework_rosetta.body:
All twelve functions accessible to both archetypes (dynamic-matrix); values describe the group’s characteristic weighting. Cluster-engined functions marked .

| Function | Weighting | Hardware basis / current anchor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Motion | Near ceiling (Hero anchor) | Basal-ganglia / motor-cortex action-initiation (2024). Enacted mastery; execution under resistance; the body as instrument. |
| Realisation | Near ceiling (Magician anchor) | Striatal goal-pursuit; turning intention into changed reality. Magician: bends the world’s interface; Hero: forces the result. |
| Coordination | High (action-mode) | Coordination in service of execution — marshalling resources/people toward the goal (distinct from Ruling’s rule-coordination). |
| Modulation | Moderate–high (active-side) | vmPFC modulation pushed toward drive-regulation/willpower, not soothing. Shared substrate, action-tuned expression. |
| Computation | Moderate | Instrumental calculation toward outcome; shortcuts over completeness (Magician especially). |
| Recognition | Moderate | Reads leverage-points / hidden dynamics (Magician) and the opponent/obstacle (Hero). |
| Attention | Moderate (narrow, target-locked) | Laser-focus on the goal; tunnel-vision under load (Hero burnout signature). |
| Interpretation | Low–moderate | Meaning subordinated to outcome; the deed over the story. |
| Differentiation | Low–moderate | Boundaries drawn around the mission, not abstract categories. |
| Integration | Low | Holistic binding not the mode; Agency drives a vector, not a synthesis. |
| Abstraction | Suppressed (passive) | Down-weighted: abstraction-as-passive-contemplation is the anti-action function (Magician retains abstraction-as-transformation, distinct). |

*Note: the Agency C-direction DECREASES passive Abstraction and Perception — precisely the functions the Seeker group (its purple emergent-shadow, the F4 function-inversion) raises. This is the geometry made mechanical: the action-engine down-weights exactly what the receptive-engine up-weights. Magician is the partial exception — its Openness is exceptionally high, so it carries abstraction-as-transformation even while passive-contemplation is suppressed.*

framework_rosetta.title: 7 — The R-class Cost-Curve (Motor-Kinetic) — the ‘at what cost’ axis
framework_rosetta.body:
First-class cold data: half the supervisor’s definition (push/pull toward ought, at what cost). The Motor-Kinetic curve is front-loaded and deceptive — it does not visibly degrade until it suddenly breaks.

| D-state | Expression | Mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Coherent baseline | HIGH output — drive engaged | BAS approach-drive running; testosterone/dopamine bound to goals. The peak-performing, world-changing state. |
| D2 Strained | ESCALATES (pushes harder) | Unlike CEN (masks) or SN (fuel-from-disruption), Motor-Kinetic responds to strain by INCREASING drive — works harder, doubles down. Strain is read as a challenge to overcome. |
| D3 Entrenched | DRIVEN — fear actively suppressed | Hero: aggressive inward BST-suppression, tunnel-vision, refuses help (vulnerability = fatal error). Magician: compulsive must-transform, God-complex, cannot rest. The engine that will not stop. |
| D4 Acute dysregulation | SUDDEN collapse | The suppressed cost arrives all at once. Hero: physiological catastrophe / burnout — the armour that never asked for help breaks first. Magician: existential crash on the immovable (death, another’s free will). |
| D5 Collapse | Burnout void / grandiose break | Hero: terminal arrogance collapsing into depletion. Magician: dangerous grandiosity / psychological breakdown at absolute loss of control. Recovery cue: surrender — laying down the hammer (the Seeker/Innocent shadow). |

**Curve shape: **Front-loaded, deceptive — high D1, escalating D2 (pushes harder under strain), driven/suppressing D3, SUDDEN D4–D5 collapse. The class that shows the least warning before breaking, because its response to load is to suppress the cost and increase output. Recovery cue: surrender / rest / laying down the mission (imports the Seeker anchor).

framework_rosetta.title: 10 — Supervisory Signature — How the BAS/Motor System Sets the Push/Pull
framework_rosetta.body:
Secondary layer. The supervisory mechanism (dACC-seated value/control + BST anticipatory cost) is set by this group’s hardware as follows.

**Toward what ought (the pull): **Enacted change. The BAS/motor push/pull pulls the configuration toward a world physically MOVED to match intention — the goal achieved, the obstacle overcome, the paradigm shifted. The ought is the result forced into being. dACC computes high incentive-value for goal-pursuit; striatal dopamine supplies the ‘go’.

**At what cost (the price): **Depletion / denial of limit. The cost is the body and the immovable. BST-cost is actively SUPPRESSED rather than felt (Hero ignores it into burnout; Magician buffers it via perceived control until the uncontrollable arrives). This is the distinctive Agency signature: the supervisor pays by NOT pricing the cost until collapse — the only group that hides its own cost-curve from itself.

**Magician vs Hero (two signatures, one substrate): **Magician sets the push/pull toward reality-transformation (Realisation anchor) — pulls toward the bent interface, prices the immovable (death, another’s will) as existential, works from the shadows. Hero sets it toward overcoming-resistance (Motion anchor) — pulls toward the won contest, prices vulnerability/help-seeking as fatal weakness, works from the front. Same Motor-Kinetic cost-curve; different anchor-vector.

*Empirical seat: dACC value/control + striatal dopamine supply the goal-pursuit push (BAS, 2023/2025); testosterone causally drives status-motivation (2020). The Agency group runs the supervisory engine at maximum drive with minimum cost-pricing — which is exactly why its collapse (D4–D5) is the most sudden of the six (allostatic-load mechanism, 2025).*

framework_rosetta.title: 2 — Group-Anchor Specification (C-engine direction — non-negotiable)
framework_rosetta.body:
The load-bearing cold datum. When a Seeker archetype supports another Main, it injects this substrate and modulates the Main’s functions in these directions. Sign-direction fixed by biology; magnitude is author judgment.

| Element | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| The concept | Per Aston-Jones & Cohen, the LC-NE system gates the explore/exploit trade-off: high tonic firing widens sampling and disengages from the current task (exploration), while phasic firing supports focused exploitation. Per DeYoung, Openness/Intellect tracks dopaminergic engagement with information for its own sake. The Seeker system raises the gain on novel input and trusts the incoming data rather than overriding it with priors — the inverse of the Ruling system’s top-down precision. |
| [Hardware] | Injects LC-NE exploratory gain and dopaminergic novelty-drive; lowers prior-precision so new input is weighted over established models. |
| [Behavior] | Acts as a receptive opener. Forces the Main to sample widely, trust the new, cross established boundaries, and intake experience before committing to action or judgment. |
| [Effect — C-direction] | INCREASES: Perception, Abstraction (curious mode), Recognition. DECREASES: rigid Differentiation, forced Coordination. (Loosens the supervisory push/pull — the openness signature.) |

framework_rosetta.title: 3 — The 12-Function Wheel — Seeker Cluster Reading
framework_rosetta.body:
All twelve functions accessible to both archetypes (dynamic-matrix); values describe the group’s characteristic weighting. Cluster-engined functions marked .

| Function | Weighting | Hardware basis / current anchor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Perception | Near ceiling (Explorer anchor) | LC-NE exploratory gain; novelty-intake; samples the world widely. Salience-coupled novelty-detection (Explorer biochem). Reads the new before filtering it. |
| Recognition | Near ceiling (Innocent anchor) | DMN-reward coupling tuned to the pattern of the good (trust); recognises possibility/benevolence. vmPFC positive valence-bias (2026). |
| Abstraction | High (curious mode) | Open recombination of novel input; imagination of better worlds (Innocent’s paradise, Explorer’s frontier). Openness/Intellect dopaminergic engagement (DeYoung). |
| Motion | Moderate–high (Explorer) | Exploration enacted as physical/mental movement; restlessness; boundary-crossing. (Shared with Agency, but here for intake not conquest.) |
| Interpretation | Moderate | Meaning read as hope/possibility (Innocent) or as the next horizon (Explorer). |
| Modulation | Moderate | Affect kept light/buffered (Innocent bubble); arousal channelled into movement (Explorer). |
| Integration | Low–moderate | Synthesis subordinate to fresh intake; the Seeker gathers more than it binds. |
| Attention | Low–moderate (broad) | Wide, novelty-driven, easily redirected; the opposite of narrow top-down precision. |
| Computation | Low | Instrumental calculation subordinated to wonder/curiosity. |
| Coordination | Suppressed | Resists routine/conformity (Explorer); follows rather than organises (Innocent). |
| Differentiation | Suppressed-rigidity | Low filtering / low latent inhibition — does not draw hard exclusionary boundaries; trusts and admits. |
| Realisation | Low (passive pole) | Intake over output; turning possibility into forced result is the Agency shadow, not the baseline. |

*Relative-Openness note (R-W2, audit-logged — mirror of the Chaos doc): the Seeker group expresses Openness as openness-to-novel-INPUT — receptive, LC-NE/dopaminergic, low latent inhibition, novelty-seeking (2024). This shares one underlying network-flexibility substrate with the Chaos group (2024, Brain Network Flexibility Predicts Openness, 10.1101/2024.01.05.574386), but Chaos’s flexibility is DISRUPTIVE (openness to reconfiguration, SN-kinematic) while Seeker’s is RECEPTIVE (openness to intake, LC-NE). One substrate, two expressions; the green-arc geometry holds — separate, adjacent groups sharing a trait without collapsing. Note the corpus records Explorer’s gift as ‘Salience Network hyper-activation coupled to dopamine novelty-seeking’ — the empirical root of this seam; the Seeker borrows SN gain for intake, where Chaos uses it for decoupling.*

framework_rosetta.title: 5 — Workplace, Relations & Individuation (corpus)
framework_rosetta.body:
| Domain | Innocent — The Moral Compass | Explorer — The Autonomous Pioneer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Superpower | Hope & resilience; an anchor of light/optimism in a cynical environment; bounces back from setbacks with near-childlike resilience. | Boundary-pushing; the perfect person to explore untested markets; navigates unknown terrain effortlessly, outside normal hierarchies. |

| Attachment / relations | Anxious-leaning (‘the Pure Heart’) — seeks a ‘garden of Eden’ of unconditional trust; highly devoted but often dependent on the partner for a sense of safety; eternal denial of a destructive partner to keep paradise. | Dismissive-avoidant (‘the Restless Seeker’) — associates commitment with captivity; seeks a co-pilot, not an anchor; emotional flight (a solo trip / going unreachable) when intimacy gets too ‘heavy’. |
| Individuation path (purple / emergent shadow) | Integrate the Magician (10) — pure trust becomes truly powerful only when paired with the will to change; from passive victim of ‘fate’ to conscious creator who uses inner purity as a blueprint for real change (→ the Oracle). | Integrate the Hero (11) — real freedom is not the absence of walls but the ability to choose a goal and fight for it; from aimless wanderer to purposeful navigator who turns exploration-drive into a mission rather than escape (→ the Inventor). |

*Note: the individuation path runs through the 180° shadow (the Agency group) — the emergent-shadow (purple) layer. The hardware seam (red) is the Relational/Limbic coupling; the Agency opposition is emergent (it runs away when the Limbic decouples), not a hardware antagonist. The Seeker push/pull is completed by restoring that coupling and importing disciplined will/forced outcome — the receptive-engine learning to commit and act. Each named integration product (Oracle, Inventor) is the harmony-match extension, the mirror of Agency’s own paths.*

framework_rosetta.title: 7 — The R-class Cost-Curve (Openness-Exploratory) — the ‘at what cost’ axis
framework_rosetta.body:
First-class cold data: half the supervisor’s definition (push/pull toward ought, at what cost). The Openness-Exploratory curve is buffered and low-warning — it holds while the condition (paradise / motion) holds, then crashes when that condition is removed.

| D-state | Expression | Mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Coherent baseline | HIGH while open / moving | LC-NE exploratory gain engaged; trust/novelty-drive running. The hopeful, boundary-crossing, light state. |
| D2 Strained | BUFFERED (held / fled) | Innocent: buffers via denial — holds the bubble. Explorer: flees into movement — converts strain to exploration. Strain is absorbed or out-run, not yet felt. |
| D3 Entrenched | DENIAL / RESTLESSNESS deepens | Innocent: eternal denial, passivity before real threat, victim-role. Explorer: aimless wandering, severing bonds once novelty fades, isolation. The cost compounds out of view. |
| D4 Acute dysregulation | SHARP crash on condition-loss | Innocent: bubble bursts → acute violent cortisol crash into helplessness. Explorer: pinned/confined → desperate variable-calculation to force an exit; restlessness becomes panic. |
| D5 Collapse | Helplessness / disconnection void | Innocent: total collapse into helplessness, paradise lost. Explorer: dissociated drift, no depth, no return. Recovery cue: a chosen goal worth committing to (the Agency shadow). |

**Curve shape: **Buffered, low-warning — high D1 while the condition (paradise/motion) holds, absorbed/out-run D2, deepening denial-or-restlessness D3, sharp crash D4–D5 when the condition is removed (bubble burst / enforced stasis). Recovery cue: a chosen goal/commitment worth fighting for (imports the Agency anchor).

framework_rosetta.title: 8 — The Six Extensions (per archetype, from Extensions corpus)
framework_rosetta.body: Each archetype expresses through six support-group extensions (one per group). = Harmony Match. Format: name (support group) — gift / curse-trigger.

framework_rosetta.title: INNOCENT extensions:
framework_rosetta.body:
| Extension (support) | Gift | Curse / trigger |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shepherd (Ruling) | Pure hope/purity anchored in tradition; seeks paradise in established values, structures, loyalty; offers continuity to the community. | Unpredictability → despite apparent stability, internally terrified of change; the stress-network explodes at radical disruption of the status quo. |
| Samaritan (Relational) | The need for ‘paradise’ aimed at the other; brings uncomplicated, joyful energy and unconditional love into relationships. | Emotional pain/distance → when the cynical reality of human relations intrudes, flees into denial or sinks into deep helplessness. |
| Saint (Seeker) | Embodiment of pure hope and fundamental trust; an absolute light in a cynical world, driven by spiritual/moral purity. | Accusation of ‘sin’ → violent emotional reaction to the idea they are ‘wrong’ or when noble intentions are harshly punished. |
| Free Spirit (Chaos) | Purity + refusal to conform to rules; throws up utopian, boundary-pushing concepts that brighten grey reality. | Pragmatic confinement → violent stress reaction when the safe bubble and playful fantasy are punctured by administrative/hard realities. |
| Disciple (Abstract) | Pure hope + internal pattern-recognition (DMN); designs/visualises a perfect world or theory, free of human suffering. | Broken ideals → extremely sensitive to realising the real world can never meet their flawless utopian blueprint. |
| Pioneer (Agency) | Optimism + the willpower to actually strike a new path; believes the unknown always holds something better and steps bravely forward. | Loss of momentum → stress-tolerance is fed by vision; if they stand still they burn out; fear suppressed until physical/mental crash. |

framework_rosetta.body:

framework_rosetta.title: 9 — Crystallised Lessons (Lessen corpus — the cost stated from inside)
framework_rosetta.body:
| Archetype | Core Blend | Life Lesson (Levensles) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The Saint | Innocent + Seeker | “My trust is not naivety—it is the bravest thing about me. And the world doesn’t always have to deserve it before I give it. While others trade, I choose to keep watching.” |
| The Shepherd | Innocent + Ruling | “The tradition I protect is not the destination—it is the pasture. And sometimes the pasture must shift so that the flock within can grow. Guarding is not the same as holding on tight.” |
| The Samaritan | Innocent + Relational | “The forgiveness I offer is real. But the right to carry the darkness with me is just as real. I don’t always have to be the light in the room—because the price for innocence is always collected eventually.” |
| The Disciple | Innocent + Abstract | “The ideal I see is beautiful—but it does not exist yet. And that is no reason for sorrow. The real world is messier, uglier, and infinitely richer.” |
| The Pioneer | Innocent + Agency | “I always step forward as if the unknown is inherently better. Usually, it is. But the courage to stand still when it is dark—without moving, without fleeing—that is true flow.” |
| The Free Spirit | Innocent + Chaos | “The bubble I live in is not a weakness—it is my laboratory. And the hard ground outside that bubble is where I discover if these wings actually work when it rains.” |
| Archetype | Core Blend | Life Lesson (Levensles) |
| The Navigator | Explorer + Seeker | “The map I draw while walking is brilliant—but a map is not a home. The most difficult terrain I will ever chart is the place where I decide to stay.” |
| The Scout | Explorer + Ruling | “I explore the unknown with the discipline of a soldier. But the wildest discovery is not the next territory—it is the moment I let go of the map and get lost. That is where I find it.” |
| The Networker | Explorer + Relational | “I discover the world through connection—and that is my greatest gift. But the most powerful connections are anchored. A friend to all is a enemy to oneself.” |
| The Scholar | Explorer + Abstract | “The theory I seek beyond the horizon—it is out there. But matter only takes shape when I get my hands dirty. Knowledge that exists only in my head has no substance.” |
| The Sailor | Explorer + Agency | “I survive everything. That has been proven. The question is not whether I make it—but whether I will ever arrive somewhere where I don’t have to survive. Resting is not giving up. It is recognizing the harbor.” |
| The Innovator | Explorer + Chaos | “The next big thing is always right in front of me—but the previous big thing still needs me. The world does not have a shortage of inventions. It has a shortage of people who stand by their inventions.” |

*These life-lessons state the Seeker cost-axis from the first person: the push toward openness/exploration is shadowed by the inability to stay, to commit, to let the bubble meet hard ground. The supervisory mechanism’s ‘at-what-cost’ made experiential: the cost is rootlessness and denial — trust that won’t see darkness, movement that never arrives.*

framework_rosetta.title: 10 — Supervisory Signature — How the LC-NE/Dopaminergic System Sets the Push/Pull
framework_rosetta.body:
Secondary layer. The supervisory mechanism (dACC-seated value/control + BST anticipatory cost) is set by this group’s hardware as follows. Note: this group LOOSENS the supervisory push/pull rather than tightening it — the openness signature is a deliberately lowered prior-precision.

**Toward what ought (the pull): **Openness / the better-elsewhere. The LC-NE/dopaminergic push/pull pulls the configuration toward novel input and trusted possibility — the unspoiled paradise (Innocent) or the next horizon (Explorer). The ought is the world as it could be, taken on trust. dACC computes high incentive-value for novelty and for the hopeful prior; prior-precision is deliberately low so new data is admitted.

**At what cost (the price): **Groundedness / discrimination. The cost is the refusal to filter and to stay — high-openness failure family: the bubble that won’t see darkness (Innocent), the movement that won’t arrive (Explorer). BST prices stasis/disillusion as the threat; the supervisor pays by buffering (denial) or fleeing (movement) rather than confronting.

**Innocent vs Explorer (two signatures, one substrate): **Innocent sets the push/pull toward trusted goodness (Recognition anchor) — pulls toward paradise preserved, prices betrayal/‘being wrong’ as collapse, buffers via denial. Explorer sets it toward novel territory (Perception anchor) — pulls toward the unmapped, prices confinement/stagnation as suffocation, flees via movement. Same Openness-Exploratory cost-curve; different anchor-vector.

*Empirical seat: LC-NE tonic/phasic gating sets the explore/exploit balance (pupillometry, 2025/2022); novelty-seeking dopamine drives curiosity (2024, with the nuance that curiosity exceeds novelty-seeking); vmPFC valence-bias underlies the trust/optimism prior (2026). The Seeker group runs the supervisory engine at minimum prior-precision — the inverse of the Ruling group’s maximum.*

framework_rosetta.title: 12 — Falsification Conditions
framework_rosetta.body:
- The group hardware claim is invalidated if novelty-seeking and wide exploratory sampling perform normally while the LC-NE system is pharmacologically clamped (no tonic/phasic modulation).

- The explore/exploit-gating claim is invalidated if the explore↔exploit balance is shown to be independent of LC-NE tonic/phasic state.

- The low-prior-precision (openness) signature is invalidated if Seeker-dominant individuals show HIGH latent inhibition / strong prior-override of novel input rather than low filtering.

- The buffered-crash curve is invalidated if Openness-Exploratory individuals show GRADUAL warned decline under bubble-loss/confinement rather than sudden crash.

- The relative-Openness distinction is invalidated if Seeker and Chaos flexibility are shown to be the SAME expression (no receptive/disruptive split) — which would collapse the two groups.

framework_rosetta.title: HARDWARE GROUP 5 — THE ABSTRACT GROUP
framework_rosetta.body:
*Reflection Cluster · Default Mode Network · Generative Incubation**** ******&****** ****Abstraction*

Archetypes: Sage (8) · Artist (9) | R-class: DMN-Deep | Green hardware-anchor arc (lower-left of wheel) | v1 · 2026-06-05

Document scope. Cold-data hardware substrate for the two archetypes anchored on the Default Mode Network. PRIMARY: shared neurobiology, biochemistry, the R-class cost-curve, falsification — the fixed substrate every Component B/C/D derivation for Sage and Artist reads from. SECONDARY: the supervisory signature — how this network sets the push/pull toward what-ought-to-be, at what cost. The 12 functions are the shared wheel; Supervision is not among them — it is the supervisory mechanism itself (archetype-as-dynamic-shaping). This group is the deep-internal engine: it withdraws from the external world to generate meaning, pattern, and form from within — the inward mirror of the Ruling group’s outward structure. All corpus data extracted from the Archetype folder + web audit (2020–2026).

framework_rosetta.title: 1 — Group Identity & Geometry
framework_rosetta.body:

framework_rosetta.title: 2 — Group-Anchor Specification (C-engine direction — non-negotiable)
framework_rosetta.body:
The load-bearing cold datum. When an Abstract archetype supports another Main, it injects this substrate and modulates the Main’s functions in these directions. Sign-direction fixed by biology; magnitude is author judgment.

| Element | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| The concept | Per Buckner, the DMN runs constructive internal simulation — recombining memory and concept into imagined scenarios, theories, and forms. Per Christoff, mind-wandering is the relatively-unconstrained generative mode of thought. The Abstract system withdraws external precision and lets the DMN incubate: it generates pattern, meaning, and aesthetic form from within, prioritising understanding/expression over action. |
| [Hardware] | Injects DMN dominance / unconstrained generative incubation; lowers external task-precision in favour of internal recombination. |
| [Behavior] | Acts as a deepening reflector. Forces the Main to step back, incubate, abstract the pattern beneath the noise, and prioritise understanding or expression over external execution. |
| [Effect — C-direction] | INCREASES: Abstraction, Interpretation, Integration. DECREASES: Realisation, Attention (external), Computation (instrumental). |

framework_rosetta.title: 3 — The 12-Function Wheel — Abstract Cluster Reading
framework_rosetta.body:
All twelve functions accessible to both archetypes (dynamic-matrix); values describe the group’s characteristic weighting. Cluster-engined functions marked .

| Function | Weighting | Hardware basis / current anchor |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Abstraction | Near ceiling (Sage anchor) | DMN generative incubation; constructive simulation (Buckner). Superior pattern-recognition cutting through noise. Detached conceptual modelling. |
| Interpretation | Near ceiling (Artist anchor) | mPFC self-referential meaning-making; subjective inner world given tangible form. DMN-emotion dual role (2024/2025). |
| Integration | High (both) | DMN holistic binding; autobiographical/conceptual synthesis. The group sees wholes, not parts. |
| Recognition | High | Pattern-recognition of deep structure (Sage) and of aesthetic possibility/potential (Artist). |
| Perception | Moderate–high (Artist) | Artist: world as undiluted sensory input / raw qualia. Sage: lower, data filtered through concept. |
| Modulation | Moderate | Internal affect-processing; Artist feels peaks/valleys intensely (high N), Sage internalises as worry. |
| Computation | Moderate (Sage) / Low (Artist) | Sage: meticulous fact-checking, variable-calculation. Artist: subordinated to expression. |
| Attention | Low–moderate (internal) | Turned inward; external task-attention down-weighted; absorption over vigilance. |
| Differentiation | Low–moderate | Sage draws conceptual distinctions; neither draws hard external/social boundaries well. |
| Coordination | Low | External organisation/execution down-weighted (understanding over doing). |
| Motion | Low | Action down-weighted; the DMN withdraws from the motor world (Realisation is the Agency-axis shadow). |
| Realisation | Suppressed | DOWN-weighted: turning the internal vision into external executed reality is precisely the function the group lacks — the Artist’s ‘DMN hyper-engagement without temporal switch to action’. |

*DMN-creativity resolution (R-W1, audit-logged): the clean equation ‘DMN = creativity’ is CONTESTED (2024, MIT Press, ‘The Default Mode Network and Creativity: A Myth in the Making’). Framework position, now with CAUSAL support: DMN generative capacity is NECESSARY-BUT-NOT-SUFFICIENT for creativity — creativity requires DMN↔CEN dynamic switching (covert-neurofeedback causal evidence for default-executive coupling in creative thinking, 2025, 10.1093/cercor/bhaf065). The Abstract group supplies the GENERATIVE half (DMN incubation); realised creative output depends on switching back to CEN for evaluation/execution. This is exactly why the Artist’s curse is ’DMN hyper-**engagement WITHOUT temporal switching to action’ — the generative engine running with the switch jammed. DMN remains the group’s primary hardware; the myth-flag corrects an overclaim, not the anchor.*

framework_rosetta.title: 7 — The R-class Cost-Curve (DMN-Deep) — the ‘at what cost’ axis
framework_rosetta.body:
First-class cold data: half the supervisor’s definition (push/pull toward ought, at what cost). The DMN-Deep curve spirals INWARD — it does not externalise strain like Agency or feed on it like Chaos; it deepens the internal loop until the loop seals.

| D-state | Expression | Mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Coherent baseline | RICH generative reflection | DMN incubation running with healthy switch-out to CEN/world. Insight (Sage), creation (Artist). The deep, clear, generative state. |
| D2 Strained | TURNS INWARD (does not externalise) | Unlike Agency (escalates outward) or Chaos (disrupts outward), the DMN-Deep class withdraws further inward under strain — more reflection, more incubation, less external engagement. |
| D3 Entrenched | LOOP DEEPENS — switch jamming | Sage: DMN hyper-connectivity loop, paralysis-by-analysis, ivory-tower coldness. Artist: DMN hyper-engagement without switch to action, escapism, perfectionism. The generative engine running with no exit. |
| D4 Acute dysregulation | DISSOCIATION / sealing | Sage: total exclusion of the outer world, sterile dogmatism. Artist: dissociation, unusable introverted delusion, idealisation collapse. The loop seals; reality-contact thins. |
| D5 Collapse | Sealed interior / derealisation | Sage: frozen in the tower, contact lost. Artist: dissociative escape, the inner world replacing the outer. Recovery cue: forced limbic participation / service to another (the Relational shadow) — a switch OUT. |

**Curve shape: **Inward-spiral — rich D1, inward-turning D2, deepening/switch-jamming D3, dissociative D4–D5 (loop seals). The class whose failure is not breakage (Agency) or dissolution (Chaos) but SEALING — the DMN loop that cannot switch out. Recovery cue: a forced switch OUT into limbic participation / service (imports the Relational anchor).

framework_rosetta.title: 10 — Supervisory Signature — How the DMN Sets the Push/Pull
framework_rosetta.body:
Secondary layer. The supervisory mechanism (dACC-seated value/control + BST anticipatory cost) is set by this group’s hardware as follows. Note: the DMN is anti-correlated with the task-positive networks the supervisor uses for execution — so this group’s signature is defined by where it sits in the DMN↔CEN switch, and its pathology is a jammed switch.

**Toward what ought (the pull): **Understanding / form. The DMN push/pull pulls the configuration INWARD, toward the pattern beneath the noise (Sage) or the form latent in the void (Artist). The ought is the world comprehended or rendered — truth grasped, beauty made. dACC computes high incentive-value for insight/aesthetic resolution; external task-precision is down-weighted.

**At what cost (the price): **Participation / execution. The cost is the switch back out — to action, to the body, to the other. High-interiority failure family: the sealed DMN loop (the mirror of the Ruling group’s external petrification — both are low-switching failures, one inward, one outward). BST prices the rawness of unmediated reality (Artist) or ambiguity (Sage) as the threat; the supervisor pays by deepening the internal loop rather than switching out.

**Sage vs Artist (two signatures, one substrate): **Sage sets the push/pull toward comprehension (Abstraction anchor) — pulls toward the pattern understood, prices ambiguity as loss-of-control, internalises as worry/analysis. Artist sets it toward expression (Interpretation anchor) — pulls toward the form rendered, prices reality’s rawness as wounding, internalises as qualia/escapism. Same DMN-Deep cost-curve; different anchor-vector.

*Empirical seat: the DMN runs constructive/generative simulation (Buckner; mind-wandering, Christoff 2016/2025); creativity requires DMN↔CEN coupling with CAUSAL support (neurofeedback, 2025, 10.1093/cercor/bhaf065) — not DMN alone (R-W1). DMN hyperconnectivity underlies rumination/dissociation (2022/2025). The Abstract group runs the supervisory engine deep on the generative side with a weak switch-out — the inward mirror of Ruling’s outward-precision lock.*

framework_rosetta.title: 12 — Falsification Conditions
framework_rosetta.body:
- The group hardware claim is invalidated if deep abstraction, pattern-comprehension, and generative ideation perform normally while the DMN (mPFC/PCC) is suppressed or lesioned.

- The R-W1 resolution is invalidated if realised creative output is shown to require DMN activity ALONE, with no contribution from DMN↔CEN switching (i.e., if the causal coupling evidence fails to replicate).

- The inward-spiral / sealed-loop curve is invalidated if DMN-Deep individuals under chronic load externalise strain (like Agency/Chaos) rather than deepening the internal loop.

- The Sage paralysis-by-analysis mechanism is invalidated if ambiguity-stress in DMN-dominant individuals does NOT produce DMN hyperconnectivity / rumination.

- The supervisory pull-toward-understanding is invalidated if DMN-dominant individuals show no elevated incentive-value encoding for insight/aesthetic-resolution relative to baseline.

Document scope. Cold-data hardware substrate for the two archetypes anchored on the limbic / autonomic-vagal connection system. PRIMARY: shared neurobiology, biochemistry, the R-class cost-curve, falsification — the fixed substrate every Component B/C/D derivation for Lover and Caregiver reads from. | Conflict style | Avoidance or total accommodation — sees conflict as a threat to connection; suppresses own needs to restore peace. | Total accommodation — to avoid hurting others, ignores own needs and absorbs the damage themselves. |
| Attachment / relations | Anxious-preoccupied (‘the Quest for Fusion’) — constantly monitors the relationship for signs of disconnection; a delayed reply can trigger a panic response; codependence risk (loses own identity in the other). | Anxious-preoccupied (‘the Selfless Giver’) — finds worth in ‘being needed’, often seeks partners to be ‘saved’; Resentment — gives so much and asks so little that they empty out, generosity curdling into silent resentment. |
| Individuation path (purple / emergent shadow) | Integrate the Sage (8) — learn emotional distance and objectivity without closing the heart; true intimacy needs two separate individuals; from ‘emotional sponge’ to a conscious navigator who feels with depth but acts with clarity (→ the Mystic / the Mentor). | Integrate the Artist (9) — own ego and subjective beauty have a right to exist; self-expression is not selfishness but the balance that prevents martyrdom; from dutiful giver to a healer who also nourishes their own soul (→ the Storyteller / the Therapist). |

*Note: the individuation path runs through the 180° shadow (the Abstract group) — the emergent-shadow (purple) layer, a coupling deepened rather than an opposition crossed (Limbic–DMN, C1). The Relational group is a hub: it couples Abstract on the purple line and the Seeker on the red seam. The Relational push/pull is completed by importing detached reflection / a separate self — the bonding-engine learning to stand apart without closing the heart. The named products match: Lover→Mystic/Mentor pairs with Sage→Mentor/Mystic; Caregiver→Storyteller pairs with Artist→Storyteller.*

framework_rosetta.title: 7 — The R-class Cost-Curve (Limbic-Relational) — the ‘at what cost’ axis
framework_rosetta.body:
First-class cold data: half the supervisor’s definition (push/pull toward ought, at what cost). The Limbic-Relational curve is OTHER-coupled — its load is the other’s state, and it degrades by over-bonding (clinging/absorbing), not by withdrawal or breakage.

| D-state | Expression | Mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 Coherent baseline | WARM / attuned co-regulation | Ventral-vagal social engagement; reads and lifts others’ states; boundless empathy in balance. The connecting, harmonising state. |
| D2 Strained | CLINGS / ABSORBS (other-coupled) | Unlike Agency (escalates), Chaos (disrupts), or Abstract (withdraws inward), the Limbic-Relational class responds to strain by binding TIGHTER to the other — more monitoring (Lover), more giving (Caregiver). Strain increases the bond. |
| D3 Entrenched | FUSION / over-give deepens | Lover: codependence, identity-loss, constant disconnection-monitoring; a delayed reply triggers panic. Caregiver: compulsive helping, self-neglect, silent resentment building. Limbic floods prefrontal regulation. |
| D4 Acute dysregulation | Abandonment crash / compassion-fatigue | Lover: perceived abandonment → massive HPA/BST flood, full limbic override. Caregiver: chronic overload → compassion-fatigue, the giving runs the system dry. |
| D5 Collapse | Dissolved self / martyr burnout | Lover: total identity-collapse into the other (boundaries gone). Caregiver: martyr burnout, resentment hardened, depleted. Recovery cue: a separate self / detached reflection (the Abstract shadow) — a boundary restored. |

**Curve shape: **Other-coupled — warm D1, clinging/absorbing D2 (strain tightens the bond), fusion/over-give D3, abandonment-crash or compassion-fatigue D4–D5. The class whose failure is **dissolution into the other** (boundary fails *inward* — self-other fusion), one of the two direction-instantiations of the abstract dissolution mode (the other being SN’s dissolution-into-incoherence); the limbic mirror of the Ruling group’s boundary-rigidity. **Mechanism grounding: attachment-system hyperactivation** (the rising limb) terminating in self-boundary loss through over-bonding. **Axis position: Limbic is the under-coupling/over-flooding pole of the cortico-limbic coupling axis** — limbic over-floods prefrontal regulation (ineffective coupling under flooding), the inverse pole of DMN-dissociation’s prefrontal-over-suppression (effective over-suppression/seal). Two poles, one cortico-limbic regulation axis. Recovery cue: a restored separate self / detached reflection (imports the Abstract anchor).

The supervisory mechanism’s ‘at-what-cost’ made experiential: the cost is the dissolved boundary, the self given away to keep the bond.*

framework_rosetta.title: 10 — Supervisory Signature — How the Limbic/Vagal System Sets the Push/Pull
framework_rosetta.body:
Secondary layer. The supervisory mechanism (dACC-seated value/control + BST anticipatory cost) is set by this group’s hardware as follows. Note: this group’s push/pull is OTHER-indexed — the ought is read in another’s state, not computed internally, which is why its cost is paid in the self rather than in the task.

**Toward what ought (the pull): **Connection / harmony. The limbic-vagal push/pull pulls the configuration toward attunement — the other felt, the bond intact, the room harmonised, the suffering soothed. The ought is the relationship whole and the other safe. dACC computes high incentive-value for social-engagement and relational-repair; the ought is located in the other’s state via vagal co-regulation.

**At what cost (the price): **The self / the boundary. The cost is differentiation — the separate self dissolved into the bond. High-fusion failure family (the boundary-loss pole, the exact mirror of the Ruling group’s boundary-rigidity). BST prices the other’s distress and the threat of disconnection; the supervisor pays by binding tighter (Lover) or giving more (Caregiver) until the self empties.

**Lover vs Caregiver (two signatures, one substrate): **Lover sets the push/pull toward fusion/resonance (Modulation anchor) — pulls toward emotional union, prices distance/abandonment as panic, fuses. Caregiver sets it toward protective provision (Integration anchor) — pulls toward the other made safe, prices others’ suffering as unbearable, over-gives into martyrdom. Same Limbic-Relational cost-curve; different anchor-vector.

*Empirical seat: the attachment system reads the ought through the other’s state — relational threat escalates proximity-seeking (attachment-system hyperactivation, the non-vagal CNS mechanism); co-regulation is indexed by vagal-tone/HRV-synchrony as a MARKER (polyvagal refuted, Grossman 2023); compassion-fatigue is the documented Caregiver-side cost (2023/2024); abandonment-anxiety the Lover-side. Oxytocin’s bonding role is held at MEDIUM (contested). The Relational group runs the supervisory engine other-indexed — the only group whose ‘ought’ is located outside itself, in another nervous system.*

framework_rosetta.title: 12 — Falsification Conditions
framework_rosetta.body:
- The group hardware claim is invalidated if affective resonance and co-regulation perform normally while the ventral-vagal / limbic system is suppressed or the vagus is blocked.

- The attachment-lead (over vagal-marker and oxytocin) is invalidated if the cling/fusion rising-limb is shown NOT to track attachment-system hyperactivation (amygdala proximity-escalation) — which would reopen the curve mechanism. (Vagal/HRV stands as a co-regulation marker regardless.)

- The other-coupled (clinging) curve is invalidated if Limbic-Relational individuals under load WITHDRAW (like Abstract) or externalise (like Agency) rather than binding tighter to the other.

- The boundary-loss curse is invalidated if high-Agreeableness limbic-dominant individuals show strong Differentiation / intact self-boundary under relational threat rather than fusion.

- The supervisory other-indexed pull is invalidated if Relational-dominant individuals locate the ‘ought’ internally (compute it) rather than reading it from another’s state via co-regulation.

framework_rosetta.title: TNM Population - The Four Yellow Triangles (Culture Layer)
THE FOUR YELLOW TRIANGLES — TNM POPULATION
framework_rosetta.body:
*Cognitive Synergy Patterns in the Deltawerken Model*

*Deep Dive: Neural Architecture, Cognitive Fallacies**** ******&****** ****Cultural Manifestation - extended with a per-archetype layer (Profile sec 1–2 supply) - v2 - 2026-06-08 - EN translation 2026-06-15 (from NL source; pending Production bilingual-pass verification)*

framework_rosetta.title: Introduction: What Are the Yellow Triangles?
framework_rosetta.body:
The Yellow Triangles are the four cognitive synergy groups on the 12-point wheel. They are formed by taking every 4th position, and they connect archetypes that at first glance share no biological kinship (no shared neural hardware, unlike the Green Line), but that — through years of conditioning, education, and cultural embedding — form a learned cognitive network.

In the Deltawerken Scoring Model the Yellow Triangle partners receive bleed-points on each Culture pick: +2 per partner on the first Culture choice, +1 per partner on the second Culture choice. This makes the Yellow Triangle the CultureForce signal on the radar chart — it shows which learned cognitive network the user has built up.

*The crucial difference: Green/Blue signals are biological hardware — they fire on Nature picks. Yellow signals are learned cognition — they fire on Culture picks. The one is who you are. The other is how you have learned to navigate.*

Source: Menon, V. (2011). Large-scale brain networks and psychopathology: a unifying triple network model. Trends in Cognitive Sciences, 15(10), 483-506. | DeYoung, C.G. (2013). The neuromodulator of exploration. Frontiers in Human Neuroscience, 7. | Benedek et al. (2014). Intelligence, creativity, and cognitive control. Intelligence, 46, 73-83. | Hasenkamp et al. (2012). Mind wandering and attention during focused meditation. NeuroImage, 59(1), 750-760.

framework_rosetta.title: Overview: The Four Triangles
framework_rosetta.body:
|  | TRIANGLE 1 | TRIANGLE 2 | TRIANGLE 3 | TRIANGLE 4 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Members | Judge (1) - Explorer (5) - Artist (9) | Lover (2) - Outlaw (6) - Magician (10) | Caregiver (3) - Trickster (7) - Hero (11) | Innocent (4) - Sage (8) - Ruler (12) |
| Networks | CEN + Openness + DMN | Limbic + Salience + Agency | Limbic + Salience + Agency | Openness + DMN + CEN |
| Name | The Analytical Aesthete | The Passionate Alchemist | The Strategic Guardian | The Wise Master-Builder |
| Mode | Thinking (cognitive) | Feeling (emotional) | Moving (operational) | Guarding (institutional) |
| Superpower | Convergent-divergent integration | Emotional alchemy | Protective intelligence | Institutional intelligence |

*Structural note: the four triangles draw on only two network triads, each used twice — T1**** ******&****** ****T4 share {CEN, Openness, DMN} (the cognitive/institutional triad); T2**** ******&****** ****T3 share {Limbic, Salience, Agency} (the emotional/operational triad). Geometrically enforced (every 4th position on a 12-wheel). Consequence for the engine: a user high on both T1 and T4 activates the same three groups twice in different role-arrangements — not two independent networks. Likewise T2/T3.*

framework_rosetta.title: Triangle 1 <-> Triangle 2: Thinking vs. Feeling
framework_rosetta.body: Triangle 1 (Judge-Explorer-Artist) analyses, explores, and synthesises — primarily cognitive. Triangle 2 (Lover-Outlaw-Magician) feels, breaks, and transforms — primarily emotional. A user with strong Yellow activation on Triangle 1 but weak on Triangle 2 is brilliant but emotionally disconnected. The reverse: emotionally charged but analytically weak. Growth direction: Triangle 1 learns from Triangle 2 that not everything has to be weighed before it may be felt. Triangle 2 learns from Triangle 1 that a feeling becomes powerful only once it also holds true.

framework_rosetta.title: Triangle 3 <-> Triangle 4: Moving vs. Guarding
framework_rosetta.body: Triangle 3 (Caregiver-Trickster-Hero) acts, protects, and moves — primarily operational. Triangle 4 (Innocent-Sage-Ruler) understands, trusts, and structures — primarily institutional. A user with strong Yellow activation on Triangle 3 but weak on Triangle 4 is an effective hands-on operator who builds no systems. The reverse: an institutional architect who cannot act when the system fails. Growth direction: Triangle 3 learns from Triangle 4 that not every crisis needs a hero — sometimes a good system is enough. Triangle 4 learns from Triangle 3 that no system works if no one is willing to get their hands dirty.

framework_rosetta.title: TRIANGLE 1: THE ANALYTICAL AESTHETE
framework_rosetta.body: Judge (1) - Explorer (5) - Artist (9) - Networks: CEN (executive control) + Openness (discovery) + DMN (reflection)

framework_rosetta.title: Cognitive Architecture
framework_rosetta.body: The triangle of controlled exploration and aesthetic evaluation. The Judge supplies the faculty of judgement — weighing, measuring, concluding. The Explorer supplies the hunger for novelty — the drive to look beyond the known. The Artist supplies the inner resonance — turning what is found into meaning. Neuroscientifically, this triangle combines prefrontal serotonin-driven evaluation (CEN/Judge) with dopamine-driven novelty-seeking (Openness/Explorer) and DMN-driven internal imagery (Abstract/Artist). Benedek et al. (2014): both intelligence and creativity depend on the same executive function — updating — and Openness explains the link. This triangle is its neural embodiment.

framework_rosetta.title: The Cognitive Superpower
framework_rosetta.body: Convergent-divergent integration. Where most people think either convergently (analysing, evaluating, concluding) or divergently (exploring, associating, creating), this triangle can deploy both sequentially. The Judge converges, the Explorer diverges, the Artist synthesises: finding something new (Explorer), appraising its worth (Judge), translating it into something that resonates (Artist). The cognitive engine behind scientific breakthroughs, philosophical systems, and architectural masterpieces.

framework_rosetta.title: Cognitive Weaknesses & Fallacies
framework_rosetta.body:
- Aesthetic Bias: confusing truth with beauty. If an idea feels elegant (Artist) and is logically sound (Judge), it is accepted as true — even without empirical testing (the Explorer-gap). Brilliant theoretical systems that are beautiful but do not hold.

- Paralysis by Perfection: the Judge wants to judge perfectly, the Explorer wants more data, the Artist wants it to feel perfect. Endless refining without ever publishing; the convergence step is deferred because divergence is always more attractive than the conclusion.

- Intellectual Elitism: an ivory tower. The Judge filters rigorously, the Explorer seeks the unknown, the Artist translates into language only the initiated understand — a network that isolates itself and mistakes that isolation for depth.

framework_rosetta.title: Cultural Manifestation (The Learned Pattern)
framework_rosetta.body: Activated early in a Western-educated milieu: schooling rewards precise judgement (Judge), curiosity (Explorer), and creative expression (Artist). Highly educated knowledge workers, academics, designers, and strategists often operate from this network. It feels like second nature — but it is learned. The tell: the user experiences this as “how I think,” whereas it is “how I have learned to think.” The energy cost becomes visible under sustained pressure: the system cracks as soon as there is no room for the Explorer component (freedom) or the Artist component (resonance).

framework_rosetta.title: TRIANGLE 2: THE PASSIONATE ALCHEMIST
framework_rosetta.body: Lover (2) - Outlaw (6) - Magician (10) - Networks: Limbic (emotional fusion) + Salience (disruption) + Agency (transformation)

framework_rosetta.title: Cognitive Architecture
framework_rosetta.body: The triangle of emotionally charged transformation. The Lover supplies the passion — feeling deeply and connecting. The Outlaw supplies the willingness to break — the courage to destroy existing structures. The Magician supplies the vision — creating something new out of the rubble. Neuroscientifically: oxytocin-driven limbic bonding (Lover) + dopamine-testosterone salience activation (Outlaw) + dopamine-willpower via Agency (Magician). The Salience Network switches between internally-directed emotion (DMN/Limbic) and externally-directed action (CEN/Agency). The neural embodiment of revolutionary passion.

framework_rosetta.title: The Cognitive Superpower
framework_rosetta.body: Emotional alchemy. Feeling -> action -> transformation. The Lover feels what is wrong (limbic radar), the Outlaw names and breaks it open (salience activation), the Magician rebuilds with intention (agency execution): starting a revolution from empathy that also leads somewhere. The engine behind social movements, therapeutic breakthroughs, and entrepreneurial disruption.

framework_rosetta.title: Cognitive Weaknesses & Fallacies
framework_rosetta.body:
- Messiah Complex: the Lover feels the suffering, the Outlaw points to the culprit, the Magician believes he can fix it — a god-complex disguised as empathy. The solution is always: I must do it.

- Emotional Reactivity as Strategy: feels too much and rationalises afterwards. An emotional reaction (anger, passion) is confused with a moral judgement; the Magician supplies an elegant narrative that justifies the reaction — but it began with the feeling, not the analysis.

- Burn-and-Build Cycle: the Outlaw tears down, the Magician builds up, the Lover attaches — until the new thing stops feeling right too and the cycle repeats. Addiction to transformation itself; stability becomes impossible.

framework_rosetta.title: Cultural Manifestation (The Learned Pattern)
framework_rosetta.body: Activated where emotional expression, non-conformism, and visionary thinking are rewarded: startup culture, activism, creative industries, therapeutic settings. The user learns: passion + rebellion + vision = success — until it no longer holds. The tell: this triangle is addictive. The dopamine cocktail of rebellion (Outlaw) + transformation (Magician) + the oxytocin reward of connection (Lover) feels like flow but is a learned activation loop. Energy cost: the user cannot stop transforming, even when stability would be better.

framework_rosetta.title: TRIANGLE 3: THE STRATEGIC GUARDIAN
framework_rosetta.body: Caregiver (3) - Trickster (7) - Hero (11) - Networks: Limbic (care) + Salience (playful disruption) + Agency (action/protection)

framework_rosetta.title: Cognitive Architecture
framework_rosetta.body: The triangle of protection through unconventional action. The Caregiver supplies the moral compass — caring and protecting. The Trickster supplies the cleverness — thinking outside the lines, bending rules. The Hero supplies the executing force — standing up and acting. Neuroscientifically: oxytocin-driven empathy (Caregiver) + dopamine-driven lateral thinking patterns (Trickster/Salience) + testosterone-mediated drive to act (Hero/Agency). Care translated into strategy, strategy into action — but not by the obvious route.

framework_rosetta.title: The Cognitive Superpower
framework_rosetta.body: Protective intelligence. Not through self-sacrifice (Caregiver alone), not through fighting (Hero alone), not through relativising (Trickster alone): the synergy is in the combination. The Caregiver sees who is in pain, the Trickster finds the unexpected route, the Hero carries it out — strategic compassion, helping effectively in ways no one saw coming. The engine behind crisis management, guerrilla diplomacy, and unconventional problem-solving.

framework_rosetta.title: Cognitive Weaknesses & Fallacies
framework_rosetta.body:
- The Noble Manipulator: the Caregiver justifies the means, the Trickster supplies them, the Hero executes them — manipulation disguised as care. “I did it for you” legitimises boundary-crossing behaviour; the empathy is real, the method trickster-like, and the Hero-ego enjoys the heroic role.

- Humor as Avoidance: the Trickster dodges the emotional charge of the Caregiver with jokes; the Hero leaps into action without processing the emotion — effective action that is emotionally hollow.

- Martyr-Hero Fusion: the Caregiver sacrifices herself, the Hero finds that admirable, the Trickster makes it bearable with lightness — the user depletes herself for others, packages it as heroism, masks the wear with humor. The architecture of chronic burnout in caregivers, teachers, and team leaders.

framework_rosetta.title: Cultural Manifestation (The Learned Pattern)
framework_rosetta.body: Strongly activated in Dutch care culture, team-oriented work environments, and familial care roles. “Being there for others” (Caregiver) + “keeping it light” (Trickster) + “getting on with it” (Hero) is deeply rooted in the Protestant work ethic and the polder mentality. The tell: it feels like virtue, it is socially rewarded and neurochemically rewarding (oxytocin + dopamine + testosterone) — but it is a learned pattern that drains the user dry: the Caregiver gives, the Hero does, and the Trickster makes sure no one notices what it costs.

framework_rosetta.title: TRIANGLE 4: THE WISE MASTER-BUILDER
framework_rosetta.body: Innocent (4) - Sage (8) - Ruler (12) - Networks: Openness (trust) + DMN (insight) + CEN (structural control)

framework_rosetta.title: Cognitive Architecture
framework_rosetta.body: The triangle of trusting governance. The Innocent supplies the fundamental trust — the belief that the world is good and order meaningful. The Sage supplies the insight — seeing and understanding patterns. The Ruler supplies the execution — turning insight into structure. Neuroscientifically: serotonin-oxytocin safety perception (Innocent/Seeker) + prefrontal dopamine pattern-recognition (Sage/DMN) + serotonin-testosterone hierarchical control (Ruler/CEN). Trusts the system (Innocent), understands it (Sage), governs it (Ruler).

framework_rosetta.title: The Cognitive Superpower
framework_rosetta.body: Institutional intelligence. Builds systems that work because they rest on trust (Innocent), insight (Sage), and structure (Ruler). Where Triangle 2 tears systems down and rebuilds them, Triangle 4 maintains systems that already work — the engine behind durable governance, long-term strategy, and institutional stability. The profile of effective administrators, judges, deans, and family heads.

framework_rosetta.title: Cognitive Weaknesses & Fallacies
framework_rosetta.body:
- System Blindness: the Innocent trusts the system, the Sage understands it, the Ruler governs it — but who deconstructs it? No one. Structurally blind to the possibility that the whole system is unsound: the Innocent does not want to believe it is wrong, the Sage rationalises why it works anyway, the Ruler protects what he built.

- Conservative Bias: protects the known. Every innovation that threatens the system is filtered by the Sage (is this logical?), tested by the Ruler (does this fit?), weighed by the Innocent (does this feel safe?) — a three-layered defence against change that looks like wisdom but functions as resistance.

- The Paternalistic Trap: the Sage knows it, the Ruler decides it, the Innocent justifies it. “It is for your own good” is the core fallacy: the trust is exported (“they should trust too”), the insight made prescriptive (“I have understood it, so listen”), the authority paternal (“I decide, you benefit”) — the architecture of benevolent tyranny.

framework_rosetta.title: Cultural Manifestation (The Learned Pattern)
framework_rosetta.body: Deeply anchored in traditional governance structures: ecclesiastical leadership, academic hierarchy, family businesses, government institutions. “Trust in the order” (Innocent) + “understanding the complexity” (Sage) + “maintaining structure” (Ruler) is the cognitive DNA of the establishment. The tell: it feels like wisdom — the most culturally respected pattern — but it is the most vulnerable to what it does not contain: chaos (Outlaw/Trickster), emotional passion (Lover), uncontrolled curiosity (Explorer). The energy cost becomes visible when the world changes faster than the system can process — and the Sage has no answer, the Ruler no control, the Innocent no safety.

Each triangle has three cognitive roles — a convergence/anchor pole, a divergence/opener pole, and a synthesis/output pole. The archetype supplies one pole; the two Yellow partners supply the other two. The Culture-layer reading (Scenario A/B/C) indicates how the engine distinguishes elevation via Yellow bleed from Nature core.

*Scope note: sec 3 (OCEAN) and the Nature-half of sec 4 (Triple Network Dominance) are supplied by the six Hardware-Group documents (the biological/Nature layer), NOT by this document. TNM supplies the Culture layer: Yellow-Triangle membership (sec 1), the two Yellow partners (sec 2), and the cognitive-role reading that sits alongside sec 4. The axes stay separate: Green/Blue = Nature = hardware; Yellow = Culture = learned cognition.*

framework_rosetta.title: The AI Reading: Nature vs. Culture Decomposition
framework_rosetta.body: *The Yellow Triangle fires exclusively on Culture picks. Yellow bleed is by definition a CultureForce signal — it shows the learned cognitive network, not the biological identity. But the same archetypes can also be elevated via Nature Core picks or Green/Blue hardware bleed. The AI must decompose the source before it interprets.*

framework_rosetta.title: Scenario A: Triangle elevated via Yellow bleed (Culture-dominant)
framework_rosetta.body: All three triangle members elevated, but the scores consist largely of Bleed (Yellow) with low/absent Core. The user does not choose these archetypes directly as identity, but they resonate along via the learned network. This is the lens — not the eye. Phrase as: “Your answer patterns suggest, within this model, that you navigate predominantly via the [triangle name] as a learned cognitive lens — a powerful strategy you have built up over the years, but one that costs more energy than your biological ground-tone.”

framework_rosetta.title: Scenario B: Triangle members elevated via Nature Core (Nature-dominant)
framework_rosetta.body: One or more members elevated with high Core sub-scores from direct Nature picks. No cognitive lens — this is who the user IS. The elevation comes from the fact that the user chooses this archetype instinctively in Nature position. Phrase as: “The [archetype] component is not a learned strategy but a biological ground-tone — how you navigate when you are not thinking. The cognitive triangle here is not the cause of the elevation, but a by-product.”

framework_rosetta.title: Scenario C: Mixed profile (Nature + Culture)
framework_rosetta.body: The most common pattern in Master-level users: one or two members elevated via Nature Core (biological identity), the third via Yellow bleed (learned reinforcement). A user who, out of his biology, has built a cognitive network that fits who he already was. Phrase as: “Your [Nature-archetype] is a biological ground-tone that you have reinforced with a learned network via the [triangle name]. The [Culture-only archetype] component is the lens you learned alongside it — powerful, but with an energy price under pressure.”

framework_rosetta.title: The Absent Triangle
framework_rosetta.body: The triangle without Yellow bleed and without Nature Core elevation is the cognitive blind spot — the network the user neither biologically possesses nor ever learned to activate. Maximal growth room, but also maximal resistance: it feels unfamiliar, uncomfortable, often threatening. Phrase as: “The [absent triangle] represents a cognitive path that is barely activated in your profile — neither biological nor learned. This is not a deficit but a direction: the path of least resistance is rarely the path of most growth.”

# 0. Cell-type taxonomy (input vs output)

The 360 cells are of two kinds, and the distinction is load-bearing:

| **Cell type** | **Components** | **Count** | **Nature** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Static-prior (input) | B, D | 216 (156 B + 60 D) | Stored biology — the priors the engine reads **in**. Fixed values, audited, ratified. |
| Post-test / output | C | 144 | The support-modulation read **out** of a result geometry. NOT a stored prior — defined by role, valued only post-test. |

Why C is output, not input: main and support are derived **from** the produced geometry (answers → engine → geometry → read main + support). Support is therefore strictly downstream of the geometry and cannot also be an input to producing it without circularity. C-as-static-prior inverted that derivation; C-as-post-test-output is the correct layer. (This also explains why 128 of the 144 C-cells sat at 0 in the static framing — a post-test cell has no meaningful stored value; it is *defined, not yet valued*.)

Consequence: B(archetype, f) and C(archetype, f) sit on the same grid but answer different questions — B is the archetype’s *own* resting expression (prior); C is how that archetype, when the geometry reads it as *your* support, modulates *your* f (post-test). Same grid, different layer, different time — not redundant.

# 4. State classes (Component D members)

D1 Coherent baseline · D2 Strained · D3 Entrenched · D4 Acute dysregulation · D5 Fractured/Collapse. Each state stores a 0–100 absolute expression-intensity scalar (semantic locked per Profile Template v2 / Engine Spec §0.05): D1 is the baseline value per archetype, D2–D5 the R-class curve evaluated at each state. The B×D state-shift multiplier (D_state ÷ D1) is the downstream cross-coherence derivative — computed, not stored (per §5). Uniform across all twelve archetypes in **stored format** (every archetype stores five 0–100 scalars identically, including the Relational pair’s neutral-field readiness baseline) — but the *computed* surface-transform this multiplier feeds is **function-differential, not uniform** (per the v1.5 changelog [L2–L4]): the same D_state applies differently across functions according to each function’s network-coupling, which is what produces the D3→D4 rank-inversion. “Uniform” here is a statement about storage format, never about the transform.

## 4.1 D5 failure-mode field (v1.7 — Component-D enrichment)

The D5 label “Fractured/Collapse” is a state-name, not a mechanism; it conflates distinct collapse shapes. Each D5 cell carries a **failure_mode** field — a queryable enum naming the originating mechanism of that group’s collapse (carved at origin, not terminal, per the Ch4.A5-RULE construction rule). The enum has **five abstract modes** realised as **six group-instantiations**:

| failure_mode (enum) | Groups (instantiations) | Mechanism (originating) | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| rigidity_lock | CEN (Ruler/Judge) | control over-tightens; Arnsten prefrontal-switch → synaptic depletion | holds |
| dissolution_chaos | SN (Outlaw/Trickster) | salience-network destabilisation; boundary fails outward into incoherence | fails (outward) |
| dissolution_fusion | Limbic (Lover/Caregiver) | attachment-system over-bonding; boundary fails inward into the other | fails (inward) |
| dissociation | DMN (Sage/Artist) | cortico-limbic disconnection; prefrontal over-suppression seals interior | over-holds |
| drive_depletion | Motor (Magician/Hero) | BAS effort over-mobilisation → vigour exhaustion | depletes |
| valence_inversion | LC-NE (Innocent/Explorer) | amygdala-LC tonic-shift; LHb anti-reward; appetitive→aversive sign-flip | inverts→depletes |

dissolution_chaos and dissolution_fusion are two **direction-instantiations of one abstract mode** (dissolution); the other four are one-instantiation modes. Stored as the precise instantiation (six values), not the abstract mode (five) — the abstract grouping is recoverable by query, the instantiation is not, so the finer grain is stored (M1/Ch4.A5-RULE: carve at origin, the more specific mechanism).

**mode_relation (the 5→4 convergence edge).** A directional annotation: valence_inversion **recruits** drive_depletion downstream (LHb→RMTg→dopamine-suppression) — valence-collapse can terminate in depletion; depletion does not require valence-inversion. Stored as a relation on the mode-5 (LC-NE) and mode-4 (Motor) cells, NOT by merging them. The engine needs it because both look anhedonic at terminal but dissociate at origin. Representing convergence as a relation (never a merge) is the Ch4.A5-RULE applied to the schema.

## 4.2 Valence-trajectory field (v1.7)

The D-curve carries, for some groups, a **valence sign** across states, not only an intensity magnitude. The **valence_trajectory** field records the sign-progression. Default = neutral (intensity-only). The LC-NE/Seeker group carries approach→defensive: approach-valence early (D1–D2, phasic-LC/BLA-NAc) inverting to defensive/aversive late (D4–D5, tonic-LC/BLA-CeA), the D3→D4 crash being the tonic-shift inversion point. Other groups’ trajectories (Limbic deepen-fusion, CEN rigidify, SN dissolve) are carried in the failure_mode + reasoning; valence_trajectory is populated where the curve carries a genuine sign-flip (currently LC-NE; others default neutral unless a sign-flip is established).

## 4.3 Transform grounding — the four mechanism-axes (v1.7, §7 cross-ref)

The six R-class collapse-laws ground on **four shared mechanism-axes**, each a single control-parameter with poles/instantiations (not six bespoke mechanisms): (i) **cortico-limbic coupling** — DMN over-suppression/seal ↔ Limbic over-flooding/fusion; (ii) **criticality tuning** — CEN over-constrained/rigid ↔ SN under-constrained/fluid; (iii) **effort/drive mobilisation** — Motor (single-pole); (iv) **valuation/incentive** — LC-NE (single-pole). Axes (iii) and (iv) are linked only by the mode-5→4 terminal convergence. This is the transform’s grounding, cross-referenced to Rosetta Ch4.A5-EXT and each HG §7. **Autonomic signals (HRV) are admissible as markers, never as collapse mechanism** (“marker yes, mechanism no”) — the cortico-limbic and attachment mechanisms supersede the prior vagal framing for the DMN and Limbic transforms.

The state-trajectory is one mechanism-axis read at four loads: D1 = the axis in balance (healthy expression); D2 = first response to strain; D3 = entrenchment of the D2 response; D4 = acute failure of it.

**(2) strain_response field (D2 cells; the carve-point — the D2 analogue of D5’s failure_mode).** A queryable enum of **six origin-distinct strain-response modes**, one per hardware group. | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Represented as a relation, never a merge.

**Convergence check — one candidate considered and rejected (logged, not adopted).** The D4 terminals of CEN (“Arnsten switch, structure snaps”) and Motor (“suppressed cost arrives at once, burnout”) share a *terminal* resemblance (sudden depletion-collapse after sustained suppression). # 1. Inputs

**w[a]** — activation weight per archetype a (the 12-arc weight-system from the bleed engine). Nonzero for active archetypes.
